description:
It is located in multicultural and historical Cihangir, one of the most famous places in Beyoğlu. In the heart of Istanbul, it offers you the best opportunity to experience and explore the city and all its different aspects.
The apartment is located on the 3rd floor. This apartment is specially designed for our guests who enjoy a glamorous, quiet stay in an exclusive location. Ideal for short-term stays in Istanbul, our apartment blends proximity to the city's vibrant culture and history.

reviews.text:
"Your private castle in the middle of everywhere"
Location is a 10 for me. Walking distance from Taxim and close to my favorite bars and coffee places. The building is beautiful, from the outside and the inside. As I entered the main door, the hallway smelled fresh (rare in Istanbul). Then to my apartment on the 3rd floor. Wow, wow, wow.
Traditional and minimalistic in beautiful colours (pink/creme). Great kitchen, great wifi, great tv/sound, great shower, and the bed+pillows: huge and amazing. Like a luxury hotel. And then with your own kitchen to prepare your breakfast, tea, etc. 100% recommended.

We really loved this apartment. It’s very beautiful and full of character, with lovely old furniture and a great, cozy vibe.
The neighborhood is excellent: lots of nice cafés and beautiful buildings around, and at the same time it’s very quiet at night, so sleeping was easy.
The bed is large and very comfortable. There was plenty of hot water, the heaters worked perfectly, and there were no unpleasant smells from the plumbing at all.
Overall, a very nice and comfortable place — we would be happy to stay here again.

The apartment is just like I imagine Orhan Pamuk to be describing when he writes about his upbringing in Istanbul. A beautiful building in a small, quiet cul de sac, elegant decor and traditional furniture. And with good a/c and a strong shower. The area close by is perfect - a local feel but with a great mix of modern and traditional cafes, restaurants and shops. Close to Taksim but not busy, a lovely relaxed vibe. And the price was good, and the hosts very responsive. So I was delighted I chose to stay here. Just a couple of caveats: First, I only had a backpack, but getting up the narrow, steep stairs with big heavy luggage would be something of a nightmare. Second, other commenters are being charitable in describing the WiFi as “capricious”. I gave up and just used data roaming. So it all depends on your circumstances and priorities really.
Good apartment with nice layout and location. Some noise from upstairs since the floor was thin. But overall I rested well and enjoyed it. Thanks for hosting

We had a pleasant stay! The appartment is calm and very well located, nice interior and clean. Some minor things that could be better (no working wifi connection in the bedroom, kitchen could be better equipped), but all in all I recommend

description:
Staying in the center of Kadıköy, you can easily go anywhere in Istanbul thanks to its location close to all public transportation facilities.

You will enjoy a peaceful stay in the center thanks to its calm and city center fascinating in this beautiful house, which is stylishly decorated, fiber internet and all kinds of household goods needed.

Every detail in the apartment is designed for your comfort and convenience. Unlike many old buildings, you can stay in a new building with an elevator.

reviews.text: Great place to stay and explore Kadikoy! Other parts of the city are also easily accessible by public transportation, ferry, tram and bus. The house is correctly described, there is everything you need for short or even longer stay. The nice touch is that the host has provided drinking water, cooking and personal care essentials. He is very responsive and was very helpful with some local recommendations. The only thing I missed was free power outlet near the bed, this is something that can be easily improved : )

We had a wonderful and very relaxing stay. The apartment is in a fantastic central location, yet it was also very quiet and felt extremely safe. It was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The metro station is only a 5–7 minute walk away, and the city center is just 2–3 minutes on foot, which made getting around incredibly convenient.
The host was also incredibly friendly, helpful, and responsive. He always replied very quickly and was easy to reach whenever we had a question or needed help. Any small issue was addressed immediately and resolved very quickly, which made our stay even more comfortable.
Overall, we were very happy with our stay and would definitely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. You can book it without hesitation — we felt very comfortable and safe throughout our entire stay. ☺️

Exactly as shown in the photos and described. The neighborhood is quiet and filled with lovely cafes. The building's lift made luggage and access very comfortable. The host was exceptionally caring and attentive, making sure I had everything I needed

Everything was perfect. Better than photos, very clean and comfortable. Bahat was very helpful and made sure everything went well. Highly recommend it for short or long trip. Location was wonderful, although it was in the middle of a busy area but the noise level was quiet and you can have a good night sleep.
Definitely booking again.
Easy, flexible check-in. Clean flat matching the photos and descriptions. Amazing location. Responsive and proactive host. An overall great stay.

description:
Stay in a newly renovated luxury apartment in the heart of Şişli. The apartment is located just 5–10 minutes walking distance to major hospitals, making it perfect for medical visits.

The metro station is only 30 meters away, providing easy access to the city. Nişantaşı is just a 5-minute walk, while Taksim Square can be reached in about 10 minutes.

Restaurants, cafés, supermarkets and shopping areas are all right on your doorstep, offering everything you need for a comfortable stay.

reviews.text: I had a great stay! The flat was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was perfect, and the host was friendly and responsive. Would definitely recommend and stay again.

Great stay in Şişli! The apartment was clean, cozy, and had all the necessary amenities. It’s on the smaller side but very well designed and comfortable. The neighborhood is amazing, hands down my favorite area in Istanbul, it’s lively, walkable and full of great spots. The host was kind and responsive, quick to help and assisted me with arranging the transfer to the airport which I really appreciated. Would happily stay here again

Staying at Ram’s apartment was perfect! It’s in a great neighborhood, very close to the metro. Surrounding the apartment is lots of food and cafes. It is right across the street from the Westin hotel.
We booked the airbnb on short notice and Ram got back to us within minutes. She was very responsive and even got on video call with us to help us enter the apartment!
The apartment is just as listed - very new and clean. It is the perfect place for 2-3 people. There is a queen size bed as well as a pretty large couch someone else could sleep on. It has a full kitchen that looks like it hasn’t been used!
It had everything we needed to explore Istanbul for 5 days. Perfect place!

The apartment is well located nice neighborhood and near to the metro station. The apartment was well described as in the photos and Ram was very responsive and the checking was very smooth. Highly recommend it 👍🏽.

Ram's apartment was well appointed, and in a convenient location near both a metro station and the congress centre.
Although I had some initial difficulties during the checkin process, with the hosts initially requesting to communicate outside of AirBnB, after this the checkin process went smoothly.
The apartment was as described, and despite being next to a busy road it was quiet inside and I slept very well.
Overall I would stay in Ram's apartment if I was visiting Istanbul again.

Many of Istanbul's most popular attractions are within a 10-minute walk - our location is super central and there is no need to take the metro or bus after checking in.

reviews.text: Great stay! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The host was friendly and responsive, and the location was very convenient. Would definitely recommend.

description: Welcome to the heart of Cihangir — Istanbul's coolest, most bohemian neighborhood and a firm favorite among artists, travelers and locals alike! This bright and modern 60m² flat is your perfect base to live the city like a local. Trendy cafes, art galleries and vibrant street life are literally at your doorstep. The tram is a 5-minute walk, Taksim 8 minutes, and the chic Galataport just a short stroll away. Perfect for up to 3 guests who love to explore and soak up the city! 🌿

reviews.text: Beautiful apartment, as shown in the photos. Check-in was smooth & easy, with all instructions provided well in advance. Umut was a kind and professional host. It’s clear he cares about his guests: he often checked if everything was okay and if I needed anything. Allowing me to check out a few hours later was a kind gesture I really appreciated. The apartment has everything a guest could need, including extras many hosts don’t provide, such as water, paper towels, laundry detergent and plenty of toilet paper. Small details, but they really make a difference! The only downside, not related to Umut, is the location on Cihangir’s hills (hilly area). There are stairs and steep streets, so with heavy luggage I recommend taking a taxi. Otherwise, the location is central with lovely places nearby, about 10 minutes from Kabataş and Taksim. I recommend this place if you are looking for a well-equipped apartment with a genuinely good and attentive host. Thank you so much, Umut!

This place is a gem in a very central location, minutes to public transportation (by tram, by ferry) and walkable to great neighborhoods such as Cihangir , Taksim Square, Galataport, Istanbul Modern Museum, Dolmabahce Palace and Istiklal street. Once you are in a tram, you could be in the Old Town (access to Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque, Spice Bazaar, Grand Bazaar, Basilica Cistern) in only 3 or 4 stops which takes only 5 minutes.
Apartment is very clean and has everything you may need during your stay, including a washer& detergent , ironing board, full kitchen, and a very good Internet (I worked from home and had zoom meetings with no problem). Mattress is very comfortable and so is the couch to watch a show if you want to relax.
Great coffee shops, restaurants and a small market nearby.
Also the host is amazing, always available for questions and ready to give you recommendations. Overall, it was a great stay and I would recommend this place with no hesitation.

Amazing location in the trendy Cihangir area, surrounded by cafes, restaurants, and an international supermarket, all within walking distance to the city center and well-connected to historic sights. Umut was incredibly friendly, quick to respond, and provided great local tips. He was kind enough to let me check in early, which was a lifesaver as I had an online meeting.
The apartment was bright, spacious, spotless, and equipped with everything I needed—a comfortable bed, fully stocked kitchen, fast Wi-Fi, and a washing machine. Highly recommend for solo travelers and couples. I’ll definitely stay here again when I’m back in Istanbul. Thanks, Umut!

Stop scrolling and read this. If you’re visiting the city of Istanbul, you need to stay at this apartment. The location, the facility, the host, everything was perfect. Ease of check in and Umut’s communication was exceptional. Pleasant neighbors, and minutes away from public transportation, including the water ferry to the Asian side of the city. If you do rent this apartment and he provides you with an Istanbul cart, please leave it for the next guest because you don’t need it anymore, the next guest does. Anyway, highly recommended you rent this apartment. It’s comfortable, it’s warm. The bed is awesome. The Wi-Fi works great. There’s also very tall fig tree out the back window that may be one day will fruit for you but not for us.

I had a wonderful stay at Umut’s apartment. The place was clean, comfortable, and had everything I needed for my time in Istanbul. The location was very convenient, with easy access to public transport, cafés, shops, and nice areas to walk around.
Umut was very kind, helpful, and easy to communicate with. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and I felt very welcome during my stay.
I really enjoyed staying here and would happily recommend this apartment to other guests.

description: "How about having a peaceful stay in our beautifully designed room? Sleep comfort with a large bed. You will feel like you are at home thanks to its central location and 24/7 reception and cleaning service. We will be happy to host you. Nişantaşı, Taksim, Osmanbey streets and the famous Cevahir Shopping Center are also very close to our hotel.”

reviews.text: I had a great stay at this hotel. The rooms were very clean, and the staff was friendly and attentive, making me feel welcome throughout my stay. The location is also excellent; not only is the area pleasant, but there’s a taxi station just a short walk from the hotel, making transportation super convenient. Overall, a comfortable and enjoyable experience. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a convenient and well-kept place to stay.

description: A comfortable and cute apartment awaits you in the center of Kadıköy! It will be pleasant to prepare meals in our apartment equipped with a modern kitchen. reviews.text: The place is just as described. The host was welcoming and quick to respond. It was resolved quickly. However, on the third day, I woke up in the middle of the night to find the ceiling leaking. Overall the place is clean and close to local places in the center, and it's just a few minutes' walking distance to public transport. However, the building itself needs an evaluation.

Although it is conveniently located, the space did not match the description unfortunately. No garden, just a closed space behind tall buildings- . The apartment also is basement-not mentioned in the description. No kitchen- just a fridge. No trash, no sponge, not even a knife to cut some fruit. No place for your clothes. Not even a hanger or a drawer.
The shower leaks a lot and the bathroom sink tiny- not usable. Let alone leave your toothbrush under the mirror - fall in the toilet is certain. Thankfully we used the “kitchen” sink. Also, the bed is two singles put together.
We stayed for 6 days. We adjusted, even though I felt uncomfortable with being in the basement… I wish I knew what I was getting. I can’t give a better rating-but I am fair. At least it was fairly clean, there was hot water and we were allowed a late check out- which I appreciate.
Konum olarak yeme icme yerlerine son derece yakın, oda da görselde göründüğü gibiydi, şebeke biraz kötüydü internet cok hızlı değil ama rahat bir yerdi ev sahibine de ilgisi için teşekkürler

All in all, the stay was a positive experience. The flat isn’t very spacious; in my opinion, it’s ideal for short stays. A few other ‘flaws’ I noticed: the bathroom is a bit small; there’s no coat hook, for example, or a small table to put your things on. Also, the lights above the bed didn’t work, nor did the WiFi in the room – it was extremely slow. I’m sorry to add that as soon as we opened the building door on the very first day, we were greeted by a large cockroach, and we saw another one inside the room later on. It was really unpleasant for us. The flat tends to be noisy, especially at night; you can hear water running through the pipes and everything happening on the floors above, such as chatter and footsteps. A definite plus is the location; many stations are within walking distance, as are various restaurants and parks.

We aim to be a place in the heart of Istanbul, one of the most beautiful cities in the world, that has served as the capital of the Byzantine and Ottoman Empires. Our focus revolves around creating an experience with local flavors and local DJs while blending them with world-renowned DJs.

reviews.text: The rooms are over a pub, but it was a good thing for me. Everything was clean and as described. Maybe I would have liked a little bit more information during the check in, but the guy was available via text 😊 the place where the hostel is located is very beautiful and full of life

I had a wonderful stay at this hotel 🤍 The people were incredibly friendly and communication was always smooth and helpful. The place itself was clean, comfortable, and had a very warm atmosphere.
One of the best parts was the location — it’s so close to the city center, which made getting around very easy and convenient. I truly felt at home during my stays and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a pleasant and stress-free experience 🍸
Thank you for the great hospitality!
Really good place for the price. We didn't find that it was that loud. the water was hot, the bed was comfortable, and the location was great!

I stayed in room 403 , it took 3 floors stairs to get there, the room is cozy and clean there’s a shearing salon beside the room for coffee or tea or reading
The cleaning staff are great, they cleaned the room even though I didn’t ask about it, the neighborhood is very nice beside it bars and cafes attracted for young people, so u can hear music during the day and night, i enjoyed my stay and definitely coming again, but my only problem is the shower water is not draining properly , and when I booked they didn’t tell me which room it will be and in which floor
The room was very clean and everything was exactly shown in the photos. The location was great, close to everything.

description:
The place is a one-room studio apartment with a bathroom and fully equipped small kitchen.Double bed with a good enough space. Including a bathroom and a kitchenette which are fully equipped. "dry cleaning" is with extra fee, i am geting your clothes, i am washing, after i make iron, i am giving your clothes back same day or the next day.
The cleaning will be done everyday by our staff free of chage.Besides, the wi-fi are free of charge!

reviews.text:
I had a very short stay at this place, as I needed to be in Istanbul for the day prior to my departure from Turkey.
The host was very nice, cooperative and helpful, the location was very close to Taqsim square and public transport which made movement much easier...
I thought the place would be larger due to the photos, yet it was very nicely furnished and decorated nontheless.
The nighbourhood was noisy in general, nothing that prevented me from sleeping though, yet due to the location I won't recomend this for a family.
The main issue I had was the cleanness of the bathroom and the kitchen, despite that the room had a very pleasant smell to it, the shower was simply not clean and the kitchen had smudges all over it, yet due to my short stay I preffered to put through it rather to complain or ask for the room to be cleaned.

Absolutely the most disgusting and dangerous place I e ever stayed. RUN!!! The Main Street next to the hotel is littered with prostitutes, pimps and drug dealers. When I mentioned this to the owner he basically brushed me off and said it wasn’t that bad and that Istanbul is like this. Any honest Turkish person will tell you this is THE MOST dangerous part of Istanbul and they avoid it.
The hotel was absolutely disgusting too. The rooms look nothing like the photo, very dingy in person. The showers (I had two separate rooms and both were equally repulsive) were covered in mold and leaked all over the bathroom, the showers do not drain and i even had them try to unclog twice in two days. Every drawer, closet, cupboards was covered in debris and stickiness. The bathroom floors had grime build up in all the corners. The shower was a trickle, literally. And the WIFI was spotty at best. I even had them give me a cable to connect directly to the modem and it was still terrible. And being that I work remotely I really needed it.
Breakfast was also terrible. You’d be better off going to a restaurant and paying for it than paying for the sub par breakfast.
When I told Oytun I needed to leave because I need reliable internet and because I didn’t feel safe, he wanted me to pay for an extra 5 days until he could fill the room. Then I made friends with a large family there who said he promised them 7 rooms and only gave them 6. So he was also ripping them off and trying to pull one over on me.
I have so many other terrible things to say, but run far from here.
Airbnb came thru for me though and let me leave when i wanted, refunded my money and even refunded me what I had to pay to buy my own reliable internet.

A good place for backpackers, wouldn't recommend for family with kids as cleanliness of utensils, room & shower below par for kids. Also the breakfast quality was poor. The receptionist & location are the saving grace.

The check in was good. Location is great. But the room was almost filthy...... And it was really loud every night until like 4 am in the morning.. The people are nice and very friendly, I guess it's the only reason I didn't quite dislike the stay that strongly.. I hope you'll take this as a constructive criticism, especially about the cleanliness. Thanks
Daha önce de kaldığım bir yerdi. Her zaman aynı fikirdeyim gerçekten güzel ve temiz bir yer

description:
Our apartment with 2 Bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (ensuite) 3 Air conditions, is located near Galata Tower, renovated and decorated in 2024, can accommodate up-to 6 person in comfort.
Literally steps away to many spots, such as Istiklal Street, Galata Tower, Galata Port, metro, tram, bus and even ferries.
We designed this apartment for families and family gatherings who prefer a peaceful stay in a central location.
Baby cot & high chair can be provided.

reviews.text:
Host: Amazing host with great communication. We ran out of some essential amenities in the middle of our stay and the host was steady fast delivering them.
Apartment: 2 bedrooms with en-suites and a small common area with sitting, dining and kitchen with essential amenities. Apartment was clean and newly built. Just a downside you could hear the toilet flushing from the main bedroom and upstairs in the 2nd bedroom.
Location: The location is really close to Galata Tower in Karakoy with lots of restaurants options and short travel distance to the tourist attractions. Tram station within 15 minutes walking distance. The area is slightly hilly and the apartment is situated at ground floor with a separate entrance. It worked well for us for mobility with heavy luggages and a baby pram but the area gets very quiet after the afternoon and noisy in the early morning. We sometimes hired taxis just to avoid walking in the dark quiet neighbourhood.
All the apartment needs is a microwave.

I chose the accommodation for the location and that was 10/10 close to metro station , Galata Tower area, close walks to ferry terminals, if you have mobility issues Istanbul in general would be a no go area, from start to finish the correspondence was excellent, helpful professional and very responsive, the apartment has everything you need and a lovely welcome pack, nice touch, comfortable beds and pillows and a super shower. On check out we were allowed to l leave our backs which was a big help. Would I recommend 100 percent I would and would I return , yes in a heartbeat .. thank you again for a lovely stay .

We had a great time here. it's literally 5 mins away from Galata tower, 13 mins from Istikal street. can't match the great location.
The apartment was on ground floor for us which worked better. Rooms were clean and so were the bathrooms. Kitchen has all things needed. TV was huge and had all OTA apps which was great.
Hosts are really responsive and great. They went out of the way to grant us some extension at check out.
We thank the hosts for making our stay memorable.

Make your not to book room A1. The Airbnb is location is in an industrial, lamp and light wholesale market in the road level. Because of the narrow streets where you will find empty boxes and containers from the shops next door at the entrance. The bedroom window is at the road level. The room is located in the basement and none of the pictures can be compared to the room. The first 5 pictures are of the rooftop but this room is on the other side of the building and is inconvenient.

This is a great place to stay that I would absolutely recommend, I wish I could have rated the location higher than 5/5, you're a short walk from everything you could want, including the Galata Tower. Around the Tower there's an incredible amount of choices of restaurants/cafes for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
There are only a couple of negative points
1. Due to the time of year we visited, at 6:30am every morning there was singing played very loudly around the area (morning prayer I believe). And I mean this was loud, it was impossible for me to sleep through it. There is a vent in the 1 bathroom that acts like a loudspeaker and you can't do anything to prevent the sound coming in.
2. There is only 1 window in this ground floor apartment, this is in a bedroom. We didn't want to open it because you step down into this apartment meaning that the window was at foot level for all the people walking by.
Even with my above points, I highly recommend this place! The hosts are also amazing

description:
Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu, is located in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy.

It is an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I can help my guests with 24/7 reception service to keep your comfort at the top, where they can stay like their own home.

reviews.text:
Emre and his colleagues were exceptionally kind and helpful throughout my stay. Whenever I needed anything or had a question, they were always available and ready to assist, which made the experience very smooth and comfortable.
The location is excellent, very close to Taksim and within easy reach of everything you might need, whether it’s transport, restaurants, or shops. It made getting around the city really convenient.
The room is quite small, but it’s perfectly suitable for sleeping and resting. It was clean, comfortable, and exactly what I needed for my stay. Considering the price, it’s definitely a great value.
Overall, I had a very positive experience and truly appreciate the hospitality. Thank you again to Emre and his team for making my stay so pleasant, I would gladly stay here.

Accessibility in the location. Matching price and quality. They treated my friend to coffee, very nice! The 4th floor is not very comfortable, the room was dusty. But the view from the window was worth it. The suitcase didn't fit under the bed, there wasn't enough space. But that's enough for a couple of days. The toilet lid falls off)

A small and cozy room with a bathroom near the Taksim square, next to a lively pedestrian street. The Taksim public transport station is nearby, so the apartment is very easy to find. Many cafes and restaurants are in the vicinity. The room was very clean, it fully fits the description and has all the necessities. Ideal for a solo traveller. The host Emre readily provided all the needed information and was nice to talk to. Additional room services can also be provided upon request.
Temiz ve güzel bir konaklama sokağında polis istasyonu olduğundan oldukça güvenli ve harika bir konumda iletişim çok hızlı ve düzgün tavsiye ederim
Its a good place, clean, and the host is awesome. Me and my partner arrived early and they allowed us to check in early. Would recommend to anyone traveling to istanbul

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: Great place to stay, absolutely central and an impeccable vibe at the bar downstairs. Helpful staff always around, easy access to the accomodation. The room was excellent, EXQUISITE bathroom with loads of hot water, super clean and chic, new fittings. Cute room with lots of natural light, cosy and warm, super comfy and delicious bed. Absolutely will be back :)

Popsteldeki konaklamamızdan inanılmaz memnun kaldık. Oda hem fotoğraflarda göründüğünden daha güzeldi hem de gerçekten çok temiz ve düzenliydi. İhtiyacımız olan her şey eksiksiz düşünülmüştü. Konumu çok huzurlu ve keyifliydi, aynı zamanda ulaşım açısından da oldukça rahattı. İletişim süreci baştan sona çok kolay ve hızlı ilerledi. Kendimizi gerçekten çok rahat hissettik ve hiç düşünmeden tekrar tercih ederiz, kesinlikle tavsiye ediyoruz.

Çok memnun kaldık. Çalışan arkadaşlar çok anlayışlı davrandılar. Her konuda da yardımcı oldular. Odalar çok temizdi. Fotoğraftaki odalarla birebir aynı bir odada kaldık. Cuma ve cumartesi biraz ses oluyor fakat çok normal zaten hareketli olan bir konumda. Ona rağmen pencereyi kapattığımızda rahatlıkla uyuduk biz. Bir daha aynı bölgede kalirsam kesinlikle ikinci defa da tercih edecegim bir yer.

Olanaklar hakkında bir problem yaşarsanız kendi başınıza çözmek durumundasınız, ev sahibi ile iletişime geçer ve onu alttan almazsanız, tartışma çıkarmaya çok musait bir iletişim biçimi var, onun dışında konumu, fiyatı, temizliği gayet güzel.

Konum olarak mükemmel bir yerdeydi. Fiyat–performans açısından gerçekten çok iyiydi. Yatak da oldukça rahattı, bunu özellikle belirtmek isterim :) Tekrar geldiğimizde yine burada kalmayı tercih ederiz. Sadece konaklama süresi boyunca odaya temizlik için uğranmaması bizim için küçük bir olumsuzluk oldu. Bunun dışında her şey çok güzeldi ve keyifli bir deneyim yaşadık.

description: In the center of Karaköy, just a 2-minute walk from the tram, Galata Tower and Galataport

reviews.text: Great location, very walkable. However, I should have heeded the red flags in other reviews. We were given a different suite than was in the photos (101 instead of 201 — why?), the hot water heater kept throwing errors and someone had to come fix it at 10pm, the shower leaked, there's mold in the living room and bathroom, no hair dryer, hard bed, and it took a lot of coaxing just to give us the actual address and check-in information on the day of arrival. We ended up cancelling our stay after night 1 and switching to a hotel up the street. Bummed this Airbnb didn't work out!

Friendly host, room as shown in the pictures show, good location , safe place to stay. Needs some upgrades in my opinion( kitchen stuff , fill up the fridge with water, cutleries and plates , maybe a microwave) and some extra bed linen and towels just in case . I’d definitely stay there again!

Staying in this apartment in Karaköy was truly an exceptional experience! The location is absolutely perfect, right in the heart of the vibrant and colorful Karaköy neighborhood, surrounded by amazing cafés, trendy restaurants, and unique shops. The apartment itself is a gem – spacious, impeccably clean. It felt like a home away from home, with everything I needed for a comfortable stay.
What made the experience even better was the host. They were incredibly kind, attentive, and always available to help with any questions or recommendations. Their hospitality made me feel so welcome and cared for throughout my stay. I couldn’t have asked for a better place to stay or a more wonderful host. I will definitely return and recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul – it’s a perfect choice!

Ev konum olarak çok güzel bir yerdeydi İstanbul’da ilk defa bulunmama rağmen çok rahat bir şekilde buldum tramvaya çok yakındı alışveriş merkezi ne 5 dk lık yürüme mesafesinde . Temizlik , ısınma , evin genişliği , mobilyaların sıfır olması çok iyi ve kusursuzdu ev sahibimiz gerçekten çok ilgiliydi giriş ve çıkışta tanıdığı esneklik için ,evde unutmuş oldugumuz eşya için hemen bizi arayıp söylemesi beyfendice bir davranıştı kendisine çok teşekkür ediyorum .

Stayed there for one night . Overall a good place to stay. The host was really responsive and accommodating. He allowed me to do an early check in which I really appreciate. The place is slightly expensive for a solo traveller but perfect for a couple. It is near to Galata Tower, Istiklal street and the Karakoy Tram station.The only complaint I have is that the TV remote didn't have batteries.

description:
The authentic bay window suite is located in Taksim, the heart of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Galataport and Karaköy, one of the liveliest areas of Istanbul

With 24/7 transportation, you can easily reach every corner of the city and discover shopping, entertainment, coastal walks and places with Bosphorus views in minutes

I provide comfort and 24/7 reception support where my guests can feel at home

There is also a terrace with a view of the Bosphorus in the common area within the facility

reviews.text:
I booked this place because of the great reviews, but I was disappointed and it did not meet my expectations.
There were good things, the staff were friendly and helpful, and there was a 24 hour reception. They did get us some extra bits like cups and pillow when asked. The location is great, bed was big and comfortable with soft sheets and the shower had good water pressure. We had tea and coffee. Great location, tram near,view from terrace was spectacular.
On the negative, the room was not the exact same one as the photos, it was much darker due to being on a lower floor in the building. It also needed some maintenance, generally, shower leaking, owner has said he will address broken tv and lights. You can’t cook even basic breakfast in this room as no crockery or cutlery provided.
Overall I would recommend if the issues are addressed.

We had a wonderful stay at Fatih’s place! Everything was as described and the apartment was perfect for our two week stay. The communal kitchen had all the amenities we needed and we were able to comfortably cook most of our meals. The building staff were very kind and responsive to our needs. There were two of us working remotely the whole time and we had no problems with the wifi. The location couldn’t have been better and we so enjoyed getting to explore the surrounding neighborhoods! Also, there is a fabulous laundry shop right down the street! Would stay again!

Was a lovely place in a brilliant location. The staff were super helpful and friendly and the bed was very comfortable. The only let down was the room we were staying in had an a joining room and the neighbours were smoking and the smell came under the door and was very intense. However, when we informed the staff they were helpful.

We had a very pleasant stay. The apartment is in a very convenient and central location, which made it easy to get around. It was clean when we arrived, nicely decorated, comfortable, and overall a great place to stay.
The only downside was that during our 5-night stay there was no service for changing towels/sheets or taking out the trash, which would have been helpful. Also, when we arrived, we noticed that one of the windows didn’t have a curtain, but after we reported it, it was fixed the very next day, which we really appreciated 🙏
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend it!

The place was as described, and we had a great stay. The location is perfect for a first time visit in Istanbul, when you want to walk around and get to know the city.
Communication was really good, and we had everything we needed for our stay.

description: This vibrant and charming two-bedroom apartment in the heart of Galata offers a cozy retreat with modern comforts. The master bedroom features a relaxing sitting corner by historic windows, perfect for unwinding. The open-plan living area includes a fully-equipped kitchen, dining table, and kitchen bar. With queen-size beds and a stylish full bathroom, this apartment blends modern design with historic charm, making it an ideal getaway in one of Istanbul's most dynamic neighborhoods.

reviews.text:
Place was super clean, and just as described. Close to main places without being too noisy. Washing machine and dryer was really helpful!
The shower temperature was a little temperamental but minor issue, and still worth the stay.
We loved our stay. Thank you.

This place is truly a home away from home - clean, cozy and comfortable with great hosts who have thought about everything you might need. Great location, vibrant area and central to everything. It is on a bit of an incline, so bring comfortable walking shoes, be cardio ready and be prepared to walk. Note that there is no elevator in the building so you will have to carry your luggage up one flight of stairs. Highly recommend you use the transportation they offer to get to and from the airport (60 euros each way). Other than that, it is a place we would definitely stay in again when we come back to Istanbul.

Clean, comfortable, and well-maintained apartment with bright bedrooms and a pleasant living space. Excellent location just steps from Galata Tower, close to shops, restaurants, and within walking distance of the port and Egyptian Bazaar. Very responsive and helpful host. Highly recommended.

Location is great, host sent clear instructions to check in, dishwasher, laundry washer and dryer is a big plus!
building isn’t well maintained, always garbage in front, it’s noisy at night till late. Shower isn’t working properly, not even 1 bottle of water inside…
Overpriced I think but it’s ok

Place is nice and matches the description and photos. Really convenient location right next to Galata tower and in the central area of the city. The only downside is the street noise being really audible inside the apartment. The single glass windows provide no insulation. It bothered us some of the nights.

description: You will love staying in these stylish rooms specially designed for Airbnb guests at our facility opposite the Avcılar Şükrübey metrobus stop.

reviews.text: Otelin konumu çok iyi, çalışanların ilgi alakası çok güzeldi. Odalar fotoğraftakinden farklı ve kötüydü. Arka tarafta inşaat vardı sesi hiç kesilmedi gündüz kafa dinleyemedik. Tv kumadası kirden elime yapıştı. Banyolar temiz ama çok küçük kullanıldı ve fotoğraflarla alakası yok.
Konum olarak çok iyiydi oda genişliği idealdi yakınlarında yemek yerlerinin ve marketin bulunması avantaj sağladı iç temizliği gayet güzeldi teşekkür ederiz
Gayet güzel rahat bir konaklama fiyat performans olarak ta iyi
Çok güzel rahat
it's fine for the price

description: You'll love the stylish decor of this charming accommodation. 7-minute walk to Taksim Square. It is a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Avenue. Every detail has been considered. It is luxurious and comfortable. All furniture and rooms are new. Cleanliness is impeccable. The building has a paid laundry service.

reviews.text:
Konaklamam genel olarak fiyatına kıyasla oldukça iyiydi. Oda, fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi ve bu konuda herhangi bir sürprizle karşılaşmadım. Personel ilgiliydi ve ihtiyaçlarımı karşılamak için ellerinden geleni yaptılar.
Ancak, konaklamam sırasında iki olumsuz deneyim yaşadım. Gece saat 02:00 sularında odamdan gelen rahatsız edici sesler nedeniyle uyandım. Sabah saat 05:00 civarında ise otelde konaklayan yabancı turistlerin düğün halayı benzeri gürültülü kutlamaları uykumu böldü. Bu durumlar dışında konaklamamdan memnun kaldım.
Rahat rahat girdik çıktık , temiz ve düzenliydi , havlu şampuan fönmakinası sıcak su herşey mevcuttu , ve görüşme sağladığım bey efendi çok kibar ve güler yüzlüydü
İletişimi iyiydi fakat konumu kötüydü yerin birde duşta sıcak su sorunu yaşadım çözmeye çalıştık fakat düzelmedi üstelemedim
uygun fiyatlı ve merkezi konumda kalıyor, memnun kaldım

İletişim şahaneydi, bavullarımızı istediğimiz gibi bırakabiliyoruz, her türlü sorunu verimli bir iletişimle halledebiiyorlar.
Genel olarak temizlik güzeldi ama bardaklarda garip bir koku vardı, plastik bardaktan dolayı da olabilir.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Speedy’s place for a couple of weeks and had a wonderful experience. The apartment was spotless, well-equipped, and offered plenty of thoughtful amenities that made us feel right at home. Speedy was an excellent host—responsive, accommodating, and always willing to help.
The highlight was definitely the rooftop terrace with its view of the Bosphorus—it was the perfect spot to relax at any time of day. The kitchen was fully functional and had everything we needed for cooking, while the beds were clean, cozy, and very comfortable.
There are quite a few stairs to climb, but we didn’t mind—it balanced out all the delicious food from the countless restaurants just steps away in the neighborhood.
Overall, we highly recommend Speedy’s place to anyone visiting. Thank you, Speedy, for making our stay so enjoyable!

Our stay was well catered for, everything necessary is present. All rooms have aircon and the beds are comfortable which are always my main concern. The area is perfectly situated within the outskirts of the hub of Besiktas. Walking to the bustle is a matter of minutes while also maintaining a peaceful neighbourhood without any noise affecting sleep.
The terrace upstairs is epic and rare.. there’s also a great stereo in the living room which was handy for our stay. The only thing missing is hanging space for clothes, they’re no closest in the bedrooms which is a bit tricky
Needless to stay I’d book again in a heart beat as we were all impressed by the comfort convenience and cleanliness

The apartment is in a good location in terms of access and amenities. The shower is very hot and powerful. The WiFi didn't reach the double bedroom and the layout means you are up and down the steep stairs often. We needed earplugs due to mopeds driving past all night, but this was expected so not a problem. On the whole it was a good stay.

I highly recommend these apartments. Having breakfast and dinner on the rooftop is a special pleasure. I chose this place mainly because of it and was very satisfied. Yes, it’s true that the stairs might be a bit challenging for senior people, so that’s something to keep in mind. Other than that, everything was great. The apartment has everything you need for a comfortable stay, it’s very clean, and the host is amazing.

The house is in a great location in Besiktas. Perfect location for those who want to visit central places and touristic areas. Everything was as described and as per the photos. The rooms and bathrooms were very clean. Ideal place for small groups.

description: By staying in this comfortable and bright house in the center of Taksim, you can easily reach every point of the city with your family. Our house has a double bed, a single bed and a large sofa bed. You can enjoy a comfortable stay with amenities such as free WiFi, air conditioning and 24-hour hot water. Markets and shopping points are within walking distance. You can reach Taksim Square in just 3 minutes on foot.

reviews.text:
The apartment is very basic, but affordable and conveniently located just a short walk from Taksim Square in Istanbul. Keep in mind there is an uphill walk to the square, which might be uncomfortable for those with mobility issues or who get tired easily.
The host and his assistant were very kind: they welcomed us with a coffee, allowed us to stay in the apartment beyond the official checkout time, and even made an extra set of keys for us upon request. There’s a reception at the entrance, which we found very practical.
The room was simple but pretty clean, with air conditioning that made for a good night’s sleep, and a small bathroom. Everything was as expected for the price range.
Overall, a very positive experience. If you’re looking for high-end comfort, this might not be the place, but for great value for money and a strategic location, I would definitely recommend it. Thanks again!

This was the worst experience I've ever had.
On the final day, the host entered my room holding a KNIFE without my consent, tried to lock one of the rooms included in my booking, physically pushed me, and threatened me to leave. I submitted photo evidence to Airbnb.
Before booking and again shortly before arrival, the host agreed via Airbnb messages to a 3am early check-in. However, when I arrived at 3am, he denied this and left me outside for two hours in freezing snow in Taksim, which is very dangerous as the area is not safe. He demanded extra payment and only let me in after Airbnb intervened. Later, after blaming me and calling me a scammer for days, he admitted he had confused 3am with 3pm, blaming Airbnb translation.
The room was freezing cold as the heating and air conditioner did not work. The place is old with no elevator. The listing is advertised as an apartment, but it actually operates like a hotel, which was misleading.
You should avoid this listing AT ALL COST.

I stayed at Mehmet’s place for 6 days. The place is ideally located 5 minutes on foot from Taksim square. The neighbourhood is not that clean but room was super clean fitted with an AC, fridge and an attached shower/ toilet. Mehmet let me check in early on Thursday morning and super kind in explaining how the things work. If you are looking for a cheap accommodation that is clean, safe and located near the Taksim square, this is the place for you. I will def come to visit Istanbul again and love to stay here again if it’s available.

I need to say that I was a solo female traveller and since it gets dark pretty early nowadays (at around 6pm), I knew that I would get home inevitably after that time, so for me it was important to stay in a very safe and comfortable place. I don’t want to say anything bad about the area (Tarlabaşı) — but it just didn’t feel safe enough for me. I didn’t see any foreigners there or even young women like me walking alone.
Other than that, be aware that there are steep hills and stairs leading up to this apartment, so if you’ve got bad knees like I do (or any other health issues), it would be a problem. My apartment itself was also on the second floor without a lift, so it didn’t help either.
The apartment itself was alright, although if you’re a cleanliness freak, you might not be too happy. Although it is something some people might not have any problem with.
Hosts were very friendly and understanding.
Very good place and people,Mehmet and his family they were very helpful and friendly , and the place very near to the bus station and to taksim , the room very clean and comfortable .

description: You will be surrounded by elegance and grace in this impressive place.

reviews.text:
We stayed at Ömer’s place and wanted to leave honest feedback, because we also rely on genuine reviews when choosing an Airbnb.
1- Ömer was very responsive from the moment we booked until the day we left. We did not need much assistance since we have been to Kadıköy many times, but whenever we reached out he replied promptly.
2- The location is excellent. It is right in the centre with countless bars, cafés, and restaurants only steps away. The building has a secure entry code and a lift.
3- The flat is nicely furnished, very comfortable, and has a fully equipped kitchen. It is easy to relax and feel at home for a few days.
4- Because it is in the heart of the "action", you should expect some noise from the pubs and cafés below. We did not mind it since this is normal for this part of town, but I feel some guests might want to be aware.
5- Shopping, metro, buses, ferries, restaurants, bars, cafés and more are all within a short walk.
We would definitely stay here again.

Ev gerçekten temizdi kendi evim gibi rahat bir konaklama geçirdim. Aynı zamanda konum itibariyle marketler ve mağazalara çok yakındım bu yüzden rahatlıkla isteklerimi karşılayabildim. Ev dışardaki havanın soğukluğuna rağmen gayet sıcaktı ve tıpkı fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Tutmayı düşünen herkese kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

Ev çok temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Konumu merkezi, marketlere ve toplu taşımaya oldukça yakındı. Ev sahibi çok ilgili ve misafirperverdi, check-in süreci sorunsuz geçti. Kısa bir tatil için ihtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu. Kesinlikle tekrar gelmeyi isteriz, herkese tavsiye ederim!

Ömer’s place was excellent. It was very clean and cozy, with a great location close to everything in Kadıköy. Having an elevator is a big plus "it’s almost rare in the area". The kitchen had everything you could need and even more. Overall, I highly recommend this place

Omër was an amazing host and very accommodating. Although the accommodation was very noisy at night due the bars downstairs or nearby construction works, the place was clean and spacious and served as a great spot to visit Kadikoy.

description: A rooftop 1-bedroom apartment with a living room in Şişli, Istanbul. One double bed and one single sofa bed sleep 3 guests. Maximum occupancy is 5 with extra beds requested before arrival (EUR 10 per bed per night). A cot for a one-year-old infant is EUR 5 per night. Self check-in with an access code. Smoking is prohibited.

reviews.text: I love this place. Close to transportation, shops, pharmacy. Cleanliness in the hotel, amazing staff. It was much better than in the photos. I will come back here.

Great atmosphere and very helpful!

Ev sahibi rezervasyon tarihlerinde beni kapıda bıraktı ve beni bir yapay zeka programıyla sohbet etmeye terketti. Rezervasyonumu gerçekleştiremedim ve tam para iadesinden kaçındı. Bu tarz durumlarla karşılaşmamak için dikkatli olun. Çok fazla oyun oynuyorlar.

description: FAMILY HOTEL WITH 24-HOUR CHECK-IN 4 KM FROM SABIHA GOKCEN AIRPORT

reviews.text: The place was very nearby to the Sabiha Airport and the Metro station accessible by 2-3 minutes of walk. We had a comfortable stay in a nice clean and well equipped room. And the receptionist was very friendly and helpful.

Fantastic stay. For one night it is worth it. You wouldnt believe that this is a 3-star hotel. The room’s cleanliness, decor, and the amenities (such as Flat screen Tv and netflix) were superb and allowed a comfortable stay. Would recommend if you want to be nearby the hotel, though quite far if you want to explore inner Istanbul. Staff were helpful too, and allowed me to check-out later at 15:00 due to me having a later flight. Overall, would book again in a heartbeat.

The hotel was unresponsive upon check-in, the room was okay, the only good thing is that it is close to the airport. The towels were stained as well as the walls of the bathroom. Hallways smelled like smoke. People not friendly. Definitely worth it just for one night if you are going to the airport the very next day

The location is excellent — just a 5-minute walk to Yayalar-Seyhli metro (M4) station (Google Maps says 12 minutes, but it’s actually shorter). From there, it’s only 2 stops to the SAW airport, which made it very convenient for us. We chose this area because we wanted to experience a less touristy neighborhood while also being close to the airport.
The hotel is very clean and located near the bus station, which makes it easy to reach Pendik Korusu, a really nice park. During the daytime, there’s also a local market right behind the hotel where you can buy fresh fruits and vegetables — a lovely bonus!
Friendly, helpful staffs , clean hotel , will stay again

reviews.text:
The apartment was nice and cozy, a bit small but very well organized and comfortable. It was clean and had everything I needed for my stay. The location is great and convenient for exploring the city.
One thing to keep in mind is that the area is quite hilly, so there’s a bit of walking uphill to Taksim. However, this is quite typical for this part of the city.
The host was very kind and responsive, and everything went exactly as agreed. Overall, I had a pleasant stay and would recommend it.

The house was very clean, and the host went above and beyond to make sure everything that mattered to me was taken care of. Their attention to detail and thoughtfulness made me feel truly welcome, and I really appreciated the care they put into making my stay so comfortable.
I stayed there 1w, full kitchen, close to the bus stop, clean place, shower works good, AC good too. I recommend the place!
Comfortable

description:
In the center of Kadıköy, on a safe and quiet street.

This new apartment was built in 2025 in accordance with Eurocode and the Turkish Government's Earthquake Regulations. The building was decorated in May 2025. As a result, our building is designed and built to withstand any earthquake that may occur in Istanbul.

We have done our best to have everything you need in this apartment, which is in a perfect location in Kadıköy.

Be my guest in this house.

reviews.text: Yavuz’s apartment is well located, and everything you need can be found nearby. The apartment matches the photos and description and includes all the necessary amenities. Yavuz kindly left us some sweets and essential cleaning supplies. However, the price is quite high, which seems to be a general issue in the current Istanbul market.

Gerçekten 5 yıldızın hakkını veren mükemmel bir konaklama deneyimi ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Yeni bina, modern tasarım ve tertemiz bir daire. Özellikle asansör olması büyük kolaylık sağlıyor. Havaalanından ulaşımın çok rahat olması da ayrıca büyük avantaj.
Ev, hem konforlu hem de düşünülerek hazırlanmış; ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her detay mevcut. Konumu çok iyi, sessiz ama aynı zamanda her yere yakın.
Ev sahibinin ilgisi, hızlı geri dönüşleri ve misafirperverliği de konaklamayı çok daha keyifli hale getiriyor.
İstanbul’a her gelişimde ilk tercihim olacak. Kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

A wonderful place that truly felt like being welcomed by friends. The hosts were incredibly kind and helped me at an important moment — I’m deeply grateful for that. The apartment had everything for a comfortable stay: water, soda, snacks, tea, and coffee. The kitchen was impressively well-equipped — you can tell everything was prepared with care. The location is great too — everything I needed was within walking distance. I’d love to come back!

Ev tertemizdi, gerçekten hijyen konusunda gönül rahatlığıyla kalabileceğiniz bir yer. Yatak son derece rahat ve konforluydu; uzun bir günün ardından uyku kalitemiz mükemmeldi. Konum olarak Kadıköy’ün merkezine çok yakın olması büyük avantaj sağladı. Yeni bina olması nedeniyle hem ses yalıtımı hem de güvenlik açısından çok konforluydu. Evde ihtiyaç duyabileceğimiz her şey eksiksizdi ve giriş-çıkış süreci oldukça rahattı. Ev sahibi de her an iletişimdeydi ve çok yardımcı oldu. Kadıköy’de temiz, konforlu ve modern bir konaklama arayanlara kesinlikle tavsiye ederim.

The apartment is wonderful — very clean, with everything perfectly thought out. Every detail is delightful, from the pleasant design and brand-new furniture to the little extras like laundry detergent and toothbrushes. We especially appreciate that everything is new, modern, and cozy. Netflix is available, and there’s everything you need for a comfortable stay. The hosts are attentive and caring, and the location is just perfect. We highly recommend it and would be happy to come back again!

description:
Located in Cihangir, one of Istanbul's most popular districts, the apartment offers a perfect stay for families and groups of friends with 3 separate beds. Just a few minutes' walk from Taksim Square, Istiklal Avenue and public transport stops.
Cihangir's famous cafes, restaurants and art-filled streets are right at your doorstep. An ideal choice for those seeking a central location.

reviews.text:
Easy check-in and check-out, with a very responsive and friendly co-host who was always available online or close to the apartment. Whenever something was missing, they were very quick to bring it.
The location is excellent, very close to Istiklal Street and Taksim Square, with supermarkets, cafés, and bakeries nearby. The hospital opposite the apartment can occasionally be a little loud, but it was not a problem for us.
The main reasons for my 4/5 rating are a few things that need improvement. The mattresses are very worn out and should be replaced. The stove cable is damaged and repaired with tape, which does not feel safe, and the stove itself looked quite old and somewhat dirty. There was also no bedroom mirror, although it appears in the listing photos. Finally, the bathroom/shower area looks somewhat worn and could use some renovation.
Overall, we had a good stay, especially thanks to the location and helpful host.

We had a very pleasant stay here. The place was extremely clean, and the freshness and whiteness of the bed sheets, the space, and the floors gave a very good and comfortable feeling. Everything felt neat and well taken care of.
The room had a good tea maker, which we really appreciated. The bathroom was very clean, and the wardrobes were clean, light cream-colored, and well organized. The lighting in the room was excellent and made the space feel bright and welcoming.
The location was also very convenient, with easy access to Taksim. There were supermarkets nearby, which made it easy to buy fruits and other daily necessities.
The staff were very kind and helpful, especially when they helped us with carrying our suitcases during check-in and check-out. Overall, it was a great experience, and we truly enjoyed our stay.

i think Özgür's place is one of the best you can find as a tourist istanbul.
everything is at walkable distance. we had a bakery and supermarket and lots of restaurants just 3 mins of walking distance.
he was super friendly and didn't matter when you asked him for something he showed up less than afew mins.
also it was cheaper than the places around it.
the apartment is exactly as described in the photos.
all in all it was a good experience 😍

General speaking was almost perfect, good location, privacy, clean, comfy and good price. The thing that was uncomfortable was the smell from the toilette. It was clean but it was always smelly. The rest was good! Thanks!
As described. Small but well located to explore the city. Close to public transit. The host was very responsive in all communications. Thank you for hosting us.

description: In the heart of Kadıköy, a comfortable apartment awaits you—just a 5-minute walk to the metro, seaside, and ferry pier. Surrounded by countless restaurants, cafes, and bars, it’s the perfect location to experience the vibrant energy of Istanbul.

reviews.text:
I had a very pleasant stay in Kadıköy. The location is excellent, very convenient and lively, with easy access to public transport, restaurants, and shops. It’s a great base for exploring the Asian side of Istanbul.
The apartment itself was clean and well maintained. Everything was as described in the listing, and the space felt comfortable and welcoming. Basic amenities were all provided, and the check in process was smooth.
The host was responsive and helpful whenever needed, which made the stay even more enjoyable.

Gulsen's place was great - right in the heart of Kadikoy and on a lively street. It is a ~10 min walk to the ferry and near countless bars, restaurants, and coffee shops. Check-in and check-out were both easy with Mehmet to guide us through the process and constantly responsive. He was kind enough to allow us to store our bags in the unit while cleaning occurred.
One note is that the street that the unit is on can be quite loud and the apartment is directly above several bars which are open until quite late (2AM+). Closing the windows and turning on the AC/fans does cover up the noise nicely, though there were a few periods where the bass would make its way up from directly below.
Other than that, this is a great value and I would certainly stay again.

My family enjoyed the place and Kadikoy is good spot if you want to be near the active Istanbul life. The area is not accessible by taxi, which we were aware of. We have stayed from Friday to Monday and on the first two nights noise from outside was heard till 4am (doesn’t bother me at all, but might be an issue if you are a light sleeper).
The apartment had everything we needed for the stay, was “turkish” clean and had extra touches needed to feel good.
The only thing that bothered me was checkin: communication was done outside of Airbnb in whatsup with another person (Not Gulsen), which I prefer not to do, however host informed me about it a day before check in, and it was too late to make any changes. It ran smoothly through.

Gulsen was extremely responsive and his place was clean, comfortable, and in an absolutely prime location! It’s on the Asia side, so a ferry ride away from the major sites, and we thoroughly enjoy the beautiful ferry rides as well as exploring Kadikoy itself. Overall, it was perfect!

The apartment was exactly as described and very conveniently located (close to the ferry and subway and next to many bars, stores, and restaurants). Most of all, the host was very communicative and flexible throughout our stay.

description: Elegant apartment in the heart of Fatih, where the place one of the most important landmark for Muslims, very few steps away from Fatih Mosque and other major places of Fatih with the highest quality furnished in a functional way for travelers from all over the world. The apartment is 5 minutes away main street of Fatih, 15 minutes (under normal traffic condition) away from Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Basilica Cistern and around other variations of attractions in İstanbul.

reviews.text: Excellent apartment in Istanbul! Great location, very clean, modern, and well equipped. Everything was exactly as described and the host was helpful and responsive. Highly recommend and would definitely stay again.

We had a wonderful stay at this property. There were seven of us, and the space was comfortable, functional, and well-suited for a larger group.The neighbourhood was excellent, with supermarkets, restaurants, cafés, and shops all within walking distance, making it very convenient for our daily needs.
While many of the main attractions were about 20-30 minutes away, this is quite normal for such a large city with so much to see and do. The location still provided easy access to all the key places we wanted to visit.We found Uber to be the most convenient way to get around. Fares were reasonable, and knowing the cost in advance made transportation very easy to plan.
We also used public transport occasionally, but for a group of seven, Uber was often just as economical and much more convenient.
Overall, we had a great experience and would highly recommend this property, especially for larger groups looking for a comfortable and well-located place to stay.

Truly a home away from home, it had all the little touches other apartments usually miss out like enough tissue rolls, shower gels, towels, vacuum etc.
Very responsive host, you can tell a lot of thought and experience has gone into designing the apartment.
Great location, minutes away from Fatih mosque which was our main priority.
2 supermarkets 1 min away with both accepting card payments and one is open till late.
Residential area which we wanted so truly felt home, all the local shops were local prices and not inflated tourist prices.
If we come back we will definitely stay her again.

One of the best airbnbs I ever stayed in. House is clean and up to expectations. Worth every penny. Beautiful house and perfect location. Cuneyt, the host, is actually the best host I’ve dealt with. Extra kind and professional and went out of his way multiple times to help us and make our stay better. Thank you so much Cuneyt.

I booked this apartment for a family reunion. It is not located in the touristic part of Istanbul, the neighborhood is were the actual locals live and that is what we really loved about the location. The Wednesday market happens right outside the apartment, and you get a beautiful window into the normal life in the city. There are many small authentic restaurants nearby, and the Fatih market is within 5 minutes walk. The hosts are very nice, helpful and responsive. They offer airport transportation service that is very convenient and reasonably priced. We made good memories at this place, and are grateful for the hospitality that we received.

description:
Welcome to Beyora Bosphorus

Located in Cihangir, Beyoğlu, one of Istanbul's most iconic neighborhoods, Beyora Bosphorus offers a refined stay in thoughtfully designed apartments with stunning Bosphorus views.

Wake up to the beauty of the sea, feel the rhythm of the city, and enjoy the comfort of a space that feels like home. Every detail at Beyora is crafted with care, prioritizing guest satisfaction, comfort, and a touch of local charm.

(There is no elevator in our apartment )

reviews.text:
The host is very friendly and responsive and there is a welcome basket too!
Sea view as promised.
However, it’s on the 3rd floor, on a hill - walk up steps outside and in the building 50 big marble steps.
Toilet IS inside the shower enclosure - not something you expect from this price.
In the attic and the sloping ceiling - easy to bang your head on.
Lack of bedside tables abd lamps.
No microwave.

It was a very clean and quiet place for a short stay in Istambul. very conveniently located in Kabatas which is particularly ideal for first time visiters using public transport in Istambul.
The host was very friendly helpful with flexible early check in. The aaccommodation is well equiped with everything needed in the bedroom, kitchen and the sitting room. The only downside of it is the cieling which can be too low on one side and had to mind all the time. Otherwise, it was a great place to stay and walk to or from any direcrion.

Our stay in Istanbul was truly special, and this apartment became such a lovely part of our trip. ❤️ From the moment we arrived, we felt comfortable and welcomed. The apartment was clean, cosy, and had everything we needed, but what made the experience even more memorable was the warmth and kindness of our host.
The location was perfect for exploring Istanbul, and we loved being able to come back to a comfortable place after a long day of walking around the city.
Our host was incredibly kind, helpful, and always quick to respond whenever we needed anything. We genuinely felt cared for throughout our stay, which made our trip even more enjoyable.
We’re leaving Istanbul with so many beautiful memories, and this stay will definitely be one of them. Thank you for making our time here so comfortable and special. We would absolutely love to stay here again on our next visit to Istanbul. 🇹🇷❤️

This appartment is really well located for visiting all the different areas and sites of Istanbul. The appartment is bigger than the photos suggest. It is a comfortable third floor space with views over the Bosphorous and a nice balcony. Yunus was very helpful with advice and queries.

화려하진 않지만 매우 낭만적이고 분위기 있는 숙소입니다.
트램 정류장과 페리 선착장이 가까워 아시아 지구와 구시가지 모두 이동이 편리해, 탁심 중심지보다 오히려 더 만족스러운 위치라고 느꼈습니다.
특히 호스트의 응답이 빠르고 소통이 원활해 요청 사항을 편안하게 전달할 수 있었고, 전반적으로 신뢰가 가는 숙소였습니다.
이스탄불을 여유롭고 로컬하게 즐기고 싶은 분들께 추천합니다.
※ 계단이 있는 구조이지만, 그 외 전반적인 만족도는 매우 높았습니다.
The accommodation is not luxurious, but it has a very romantic and charming atmosphere.
With a tram stop and ferry terminal just nearby, it offers excellent access to both the Asian side and the Old City, making it an even better choice than staying right in the center of Taksim.
What stood out the most was the host — extremely responsive and attentive to requests, which made the stay feel comfortable and trustworthy.
Highly recommended for travelers who want to experience Istanbul in a relaxed, local way

description: Welcome to your modern city retreat! This bright and thoughtfully designed 2BD/1Bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort and creativity in the heart of Ortakoy. Set on a charming hillside in a vibrant neighborhood, you're just minutes away from local cafes, shops, and public transport. The area offers an authentic taste of local life while staying close to city highlights. Ideal for couples, solo travelers, or remote workers looking for a fresh and functional stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text: Her şey çok güzeldi. Sadece çok uzun süre kaldığımız için havluları yıkayamamak/ değiştirememek problem oldu. 7 gün boyunca aynı havluyu kullanmak zorunda kaldık. Bir de caddede otopark sorunu vardı ve biraz gürültülüydü. Bunun dışında tertemiz ve düzenliydi, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi ile iletişim kurmak da çok rahattı sorulara hemen cevap verdiler. Teşekkürler.
Sadece fotolarda 2 çift kişilik yatak görünüyor ama 1 çift 1 tek yatak vardı.. onun haricinde temiz konum da iyi
çok rahattı temizdi konumu da iyi güzeldi kısaca

Very quiet location, at least in was during my stay. Very near to Bosporus, nice cafes, fresh air. There is a small shop in the same building. Apartment is spacious and clean, to the side of the sunrise.
Fresh, very clean, nice and tidy… Compact and comfortable. An enjoyable place for both short or long-term stays.

🛏 Two cozy bedrooms & two modern bathrooms
🍽 Fully equipped kitchen with dishwasher

📺 Smart TV with Netflix + fast Wi-Fi
🏋️‍♂️ Gym access

🚇 Just 5 minutes to the metro

Located in one of Istanbul’s best areas — peaceful, central, and walkable.

Perfect for couples, families, and business travelers.

reviews.text: The apartment was modern and clean. We felt very comfortable.The host was very friendly and helpful. Great location, close to shops and restaurants. Highly recommend !!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Absolutely incredible stay! This apartment was perfect in every way — clean, cozy, and very comfortable. It truly felt like home and made our stay in Istanbul even more special.
But the highlight was without a doubt the host. He is one of the kindest and most welcoming people we’ve ever met. Always smiling, extremely helpful, and genuinely caring, he went above and beyond to make sure we had the best possible experience. We absolutely adored him!
I cannot recommend this place enough. If you’re coming to Istanbul, don’t hesitate for a second — this is the place to stay. We would 100% come back! Thanks for everything Mohammad 🙏
Great location, close to the metro, little grocery store nearby.
Amazing place, with amazing people. Super close to the metro station, right next to a place where you can drink your coffee and eat your breakfast.❤️
Thanks for everything all was good and your asst Mohmad was very helpful

description: Our apartment offers comfortable accommodation for up to four guests with two bedrooms. In the spacious living room, you can enjoy a movie night, play Xbox, or listen to music with the Marshall sound system. The open kitchen, bright bathroom, and practical amenities make it suitable for both short and long stays. The most enjoyable space is the terrace, decorated with seating areas—perfect for sipping your coffee or having pleasant evening conversations accompanied by music.Located on -1 floor

reviews.text:
Modern apartment with all the amenities and spotless clean. Location is excellent with some shops open 24/7 nearby. Huge TV which was nice during the World Cup.
Only thing to be aware of is that the apartment is at -1 (as indicated in the listing). The bedrooms are right below the street but near the building entrance. You will hear some noise from people walking by, entering the building in the middle of the night or cars/motorbikes passing by. There isn’t much the host can do here, so bring earplugs if you are a light sleeper like me. I brought one and slept without issues.
We loved the location and will book again if we need an accommodation in Istanbul. Thank you for everything.

I had a wonderful stay at Zeynep’s apartment. The check-in instructions were very clear and easy to follow, which made the whole arrival process smooth and stress-free. The location is fantastic, close to all types of public transportation, as well as many great restaurants and bars, making it very convenient to explore the area.
Zeynep was a very helpful host and always responded quickly whenever I had a question. The apartment itself was extremely neat and clean, and everything was well maintained. All the equipment worked perfectly, which made the stay very comfortable.
One of the highlights was the large and beautiful terrace with a lovely seating area, it was a great place to relax and enjoy the atmosphere.
Overall, it was a 10/10 experience. I would definitely come back and highly recommend Zeynep’s place to anyone visiting the area.

We stayed at Zeynep's place for 10 days and honestly couldn’t have asked for a better experience.Her place made me regret staying at other places during out trip.The moment we walked in,we noticed the little gift on the coffee table,the YUMMY floral scent,the most beautiful interior design etc..As someone who is a clean freak,I almost cried happy tears because this apartment was SPOTLESS and beautifully maintained. My husband had to work from home and it had everything we needed for a comfortable stay and workspace. So many clean towels in both rooms,multiple slippers in unopened packages,iron,iron board,vacuum, washing machine,pots & pans..you name it!We also had a lovely outdoor space we unfortunately could not use due to rainy weather but it looked beautiful and so serene.What truly made the stay special was the host,Zeynep: kind, responsive, and always willing to help with any questions.I felt completely at home from the moment I arrived & I’d happily stay here again and AGAIN!

We had a wonderful stay at Zeynep's cozy Kadıköy apartment with my partner and her daughter. The place was spotlessly clean with new amenities, and the temperature was perfectly warm during the chilly January days. The little private yard area was a nice touch, and the Xbox was a fun surprise that kept us entertained!
Zeynep was responsive and helpful throughout, making check-in and check-out completely hassle-free. The Kadıköy location was convenient for exploring the neighborhood's cafes and markets.
One small note for future guests: the apartment is on the basement level, which wasn't an issue for us but worth knowing beforehand.
We'd happily return and recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Amazing! definitely will repeat.
Bedding was comfortable. lots of trendy, tasty, gourmet places all around the area. Great communication & very professional & reliable! Impeccably clean and spotless. Wifi & table setup was perfect so could be very productive too. Love the place a lot.

description: Comfortable 2+1 flat for 4 people in the heart of Moda. It is a few steps away from Kadıköy's popular cafes, restaurants and bars. Since the living room and bedroom overlook a quiet garden, it offers a peaceful stay despite its central location. It is within walking distance to Moda Beach, Kadıköy Bazaar, ferry, metro and Marmaray. It is ideal for guests who want to experience Istanbul like a real Kadıköy resident.

reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at Taunahan’s apartment. It sits in the heart of Moda, one of my favourite neighbourhoods in Istanbul. The apartment itself felt like home. Very clean, homey and has personal touches without the clutter. I had everything I needed to have a very comfortable stay. Temperature and bed were perfect for a goodnight sleep. Kitchen and bathroom were clean and well equipped. Taunahan was really sweet and communicated everything perfectly. Check in and check out was very easy. One of the best stays I had in Istanbul. Would definitely book again ❤️

Very nice location with lots to do around, close to public transport and train station. The rooms were clean and the host was very communicative. Since the location is very lively, one of the bedrooms can get a little bit loud at night but it wasn't a problem for me.

I checked-in during the night, and apartments on the floor are not numbered. Accidentally woke up the neighbour by trying to open his door with a key. Leaving the key at apotheke nearby is not the best option. Buy a locker box and put it on the door. Apartment and the building are old and need renovation, but it was clean inside. Shower is ok. Kitchen is old and poor, no corkscrew to open a bottle of wine. No wine glasses. No beer glasses. Location is nice. Overall it was ok but overpriced, like everything in Istanbul.

Konumu ve ev sahibin iletişimi oldukça iyiydi. Temizlik ürünleri, ihtiyaç duyulabilecek her şey düşünülmüştü. Ev ve yataklar gerçekten pırıl pırıldı, tertemiz kokuyordu. Bu konuda çok rahat ettik, tekrar konaklamak isteyeceğimiz bir ev oldu.

Very clean and nice place in great neighborhood, everything is just as per pictures. Host is very responsive and communicative. We had problems with fridge and we got help immediately. The only thing - I wouldn’t recommend with kids as our 1yo cried 15min at night (teeth pain) and neighbors were making complains to us and host. We were notified that if it repeats we will have to leave. This put some pressure on us of course, as it’s not something we can control, but all was good in the end. We enjoyed our stay!

description: Our historic building, built in the late 19th century, is located in one of Istanbul’s most central and prestigious areas. It is just 1 minute walking distance from Istiklal Street, and within easy reach of Kabataş Pier, Galata Tower and all public transport. The area is full of cafés and restaurants, yet safe and quiet. The building is believed to have been built by Armenian and Greek stone masters.

reviews.text:
My family and I stayed in this amazing house for 14 days and everything was beautiful and extremely clean. The apartment had everything we needed for a comfortable long stay.
The location was definitely the highlight! very close to fruit markets, cafés, local and international restaurants, clothing stores and everything else we needed. Since our main goal was to explore Istanbul, booking this place was the best decision. We even walked to Galata Tower a few times, which is only about 900 meters away. Main Street of the neighborhood is about 20 meters away from the house. It’s a fun walk with plenty to see and do along the way.
We were four people, and I was initially worried about having only one bathroom, but it worked out perfectly. We chose this place because of its fantastic location and beautiful artistic design, and we have no regrets. It was definitely worth the price.
Thank you to the host for always being friendly and understanding! We can’t wait to come back soon.

Buğra's apartment was the perfect place for my friend and I to spend a week in Istanbul. It's a terrific location, an easy walk to Taksim Square and a lovely stroll along İstiklal Street. But's it's perfectly tucked away from the congestion and noise on a pedestrian only street lined with outdoor dining. And there are three beautiful balconies overlooking the street below.
It's especially clean and spacious, with a well-stocked kitchen and comfortable beds.
Co-host Matanat was efficient, gracious and proactive. It was the kind of Airbnb service everyone hopes for on their trip.
Five stars all around!

What a beautiful flat! We only stayed for one night, but we truly wished we could have stayed longer. Everything in the apartment is so stylish and thoughtfully designed. The photos already looked lovely, but the place is even nicer in person.
The flat was very well equipped with everything we needed, and we really appreciated the complimentary water left in the fridge.
