The host was always friendly, responsive, and proactive with communication. We especially enjoyed the flexible check-in process, which was incredibly smooth and convenient. The host provided all the necessary details in advance and answered all of our questions promptly.
The flat is located on a very lively street, so there was music that we could hear until late at night. However, this wasn’t a problem for us at all - we actually wanted to stay right in the middle of everything and enjoyed the vibrant atmosphere.
We would happily stay here again and highly recommend it!

This apartment is truly full of soul and thoughtful details. From the authentic brick ceilings and walls to the beautifully designed bathroom, every corner of the space reflects creativity and character. In fact, the entire apartment feels like a genuine piece of art.
A big bravo to the owner Bugra for creating such a unique and inspiring design. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for something special.
What is also impressed me the exceptional hospitality. I was traveling alone with my baby, and the owner kindly helped me with both check-in and check-out, including carrying my luggage, which was helpful since the apartment is on the second floor without an elevator.
The apartment is comfy and clean we even used the washing machine and dish washer .
The kitchen is also fully equipped, making the stay even more comfortable and convenient.
I am truly impressed by everything this apartment offers, and I will definitely come back again… with love from Cherkes 🩷

We had a fantastic one week stay and would happily stay here again.
The location is outstanding. Easy access to every type of transport (metro, tram, buses and ferries), and even a convenient metro connection to the airport. We found it incredibly easy to get anywhere in Istanbul from here.
The neighborhood is wonderful to explore on foot, with plenty of great cafés and breakfast spots within a short walk. It felt lively and local while still being very convenient.
The apartment itself was comfortable and well-equipped. The bed was very comfortable, communication with the host was excellent throughout our stay, and everything was exactly as described.
A special mention goes to the bathroom with the projector. Our daughter absolutely fell in love with it and it became one of her favorite parts of the trip :)
Honestly, we have nothing to complain about. A wonderful apartment, a fantastic location, and a host who made everything easy. Highly recommended!!! Thank you so much 😊

description: Although Garden Bosphorus NO:9 is located in the center of Istanbul, it offers a peaceful and quiet accommodation experience in a 2-acre lush garden, away from the noise of the city. You can feel like you're in a resort, starting your day with the sound of birds and a complimentary breakfast. We offer our guests comfort that rivals home and an unforgettable experience. You won’t want to leave this unique place, which is one of the rare examples of its kind.

reviews.text: Excellent location. Clean and cosy rooms. Very hospitable hosts. In overall, great value for the money.
Çok kibar ve yardımcı bir ev sahibi. Oda, tuvalet, yatak çarşafları her şey temizdi. Çok rahat ederek kaldık. Teşekkür ederiz.

A very cozy villa. The room is large, the bed is super comfortable (I didn't want to get out of it at all (: ), and the balcony has a wonderful view of the garden and birds. The host is very responsive, thank you for your hospitality!

Would just like to say thank you for such a lovely stay..
The place was so clean and the staff were so helpful and friendly
I feel like I got an awesome bargain and the place was perfect to get a little touch of nature in the middle of busy Istanbul.
The only thing is it is at the top of a high hill so you have to be relatively fit to climb it but great exercise
Thank you again 🙏
Clean and peaceful! Very easy. Strong recommend if you’re staying in Ortakoy or hanging out near Beşiktaş.

description:
Welcome to your home away from home in the vibrant Firuzağa neighborhood of Beyoğlu, Istanbul! This stylish and modern apartment offers

Bright and airy interiors: Tasteful décor with natural wood elements and fresh greenery for a cozy atmosphere.
Comfortable sleeping arrangements: A queen bed and a sofa bed for an extra guest.
Perfect for short or long stays: Ideal for couples, solo travelers, or small families seeking a comfortable base in Istanbul.

reviews.text: I had a fantastic stay! The place was comfortable, in the perfect location, and exactly as described. The host was friendly, responsive, and made everything easy. It was an all-around wonderful experience and perfect for couple or solo traveler. I’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it!
The apartment was exactly as described. The host was super responsive and helped us a lot and the location was so nice.
The place is located in downtown, best location you can get with decent pricing. I liked how clean was the unit and how responsive was the team. Thank you all and see you again soon

The apartment was very good location next to lots of restaurants, shops and bars. Walking distance to Galata tower and close to a Galata bridge convenient for seeing other sights. The apartment was clean had everything we needed. Had lovely balcony and lots of natural light. Came with towels, toiletries, hairdryer which was all very useful. Overall a great experience.

Good apartment in a good location, but the shower drained poorly, and water spilled out of the bathtub and spread across the living area. This made it practically impossible to use the shower. And a little bit noisy in the night.

description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you'll be close to everything as a family.

reviews.text:
Great stay overall! The host was fantastic—very responsive, friendly, and helpful, which made everything easy and stress-free. The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described.
The location was a big highlight, with lots of restaurants and cafes just steps away. One small thing to note is that the downstairs bathroom is a compact half-bath with limited lighting, but it didn’t impact our stay.
Would definitely recommend and would happily return!

We stayed here as a family of five (all adults). This place offers you the comfort of your house and located on a street with cute Ottoman style houses. Air conditioning in the house allows you to have a restful sleep at night. Lots of markets around if you would like to cook at home. Otherwise, many restaurants for all kinds of budget. Many historical places within short walking distance. Area is safe and what is best is the host: A great person who is responsive, helpful and friendly.

Loved the area, not dominated by tourists and had a lovely authentic Turkish feel about the area. So calm and quiet. Absolutely loved the area/neighbourhood (called Kardiga). Walking distance to most attractions like Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque and Grand Bazaar (around 15 mins walk to each, but uphill).
The accommodation was clean and comfortable, responsive host too.
Would definitely recommend

Worth the money you pay. There are some inconveniences. The distance from the house to public transport is far and uphill. You can't really eat around in the area as its quite a tourist trap. Some amenities were missing but its no big deal. The AC worked well. The host was responsive and friendly. Would recommend if you're ready for a walk to get some good and reasonably priced food. Overall 4/5! Thanks!

Onur is an incredible host and he made sure we were comfortable. AirBnB is located right in the middle of Fatih which is close to Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque with a lot of options to eat and the area was quite peaceful.

description: Modern apartment in Kadıköy featuring 2 bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, living area, and TV—offering both comfort and privacy. Includes a compact kitchen, air conditioning, and elevator access. Located within walking distance to cafés, restaurants, markets, and public transport. Ideal for families or groups seeking a clean, comfortable, and centrally located stay in Istanbul.

reviews.text:
My daughter and myself had such a restful stay at Berk's modern loft apartment located in the popular Kadıköy neighborhood in Istanbul.
It was quiet, the beds are very comfortable, the bathrooms are modern, and with lots of amenities.
As we were between a hotel stay and getting on another plane- being able to do laundry was a game changer.
The dishwasher was wonderful and unusual with a kitchenette. The cooking space is small but this makes sense since one is surrounded by literally hundreds of amazing restaurants and cafes. Even the cafeteria-styled restaurants in this area are hearty delicious with massive portions at low prices.
This space is more like two studios with au suite bathrooms connected by a kitchenette. Great option for privacy for two couples or a family with kids.
Only two observations:
Though there is an elevator one still has to do two sets of stairs.
This is a converted attic space so the ceiling is unusual and low in parts.
Would stay again definitely.

Konum mükemmel. Kadıköy çarşıya, yeme-içme mekanlarına yürüme mesafesinde. Giriş çıkış son derece kolay, evi bulmak da aynı şekilde. Resimlerdeki gibi düzenli ve temiz konforlu bir evdi. Klimalardan birinin İki kişilik yatak odasında değil iki odayı birleştiren mutfak alanında olduğunu ve odaya girdiğimde çatı katının vermiş olduğu sıcaklığı görünce klimanın serinletmeyeceğini düşündüm ve bu beni gerdi( Sıcaklık hissi kişisel bir sağlık sorunumla alakalı) Ev sahibine yazdığımda klimanın yeterli geleceğini, gelmezse de bana bir vantilatör tedarik edebileceklerini söyledi. Bir süre sonra vantilatörü istemeye karar verdim ve hemen getirdiler. Ancak gece gerçekten dedikleri gibi oda yeterince serinledi ve ilk günümüzün ilk saatleri haricinde vantilatöre ihtiyaç kalmadı. Ne sorsam, ne istesem hızla ve büyük nezaketle karşılık verdiler, çıkış saati konusunda da sağ olsunlar yardımcı oldular. Neticede son derece tavsiye ederim ve tekrar kalırım.

A perfect, top-floor pad in one of the coolest, most balanced neighborhoods I've ever visited. The space was bright and clean with quirky architecture, plus views of the surrounding buildings and the water. The neighborhood was alive yet safe. Bustling yet intimate, communal. There are people out at all hours, but I never felt as though I needed to put my wallet in my front pocket. When you need sanctuary, the apartment is quiet and well insulated from the action. It's 2 blocks from the water, a few blocks from the ferry and metro, and nestled between so many restaurants, bodegas, vendor markets, and hidden streets with their own character, that I doubt I managed to see them all. I forgot to set up cell service and was able to do it at a nearby store; brought a broken camera by accident and was able to find a replacement at a nearby antique store. There's also a currency exchange nearby. Hosts were responsive and understanding. I'd love to stay here again and highly recommend it.

Berk was a very kind and helpful host. The apartment is in a very central and convenient location in Kadıköy. It was clean, tidy, and comfortable for our stay. The check-in and check-out process was smooth as well. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone staying in Kadıköy. Thank you, Berk!

Staying at Berk’s place was honestly a 10/10 experience. Communication with him was excellent, very responsive, even before coming. We were scared at first since this is our first booking without any comments and we think this is a brand new listing as all amenities inside were clean and looked unused. But we were pleasantly surprised to see that the listing is exactly the same as reality. Berk provided everything, and was responsive and quick when we needed anything else.
We recommend adding more hangers for more guests, and more towels for longer stays. Other than that, we had a perfect stay, the location was close to everything and we couldn’t ask for a better place. If we come back to Kadikoy, we hope to stay at Berk’s again.

description:
Conveniently set in Istanbul, Homelike Hotel provides air-conditioned rooms, a restaurant and free WiFi. The property is located 2 km from Istiklal Street. The accommodation features a 24-hour front desk.

All units at the hotel are equipped with a TV with satellite channels and a safety deposit box. The private bathroom is equipped with a shower, free toiletries and a hairdryer. At Hotel each room include towels

Popular points of interest near the accommodation include Istanbul Taksim Square.

reviews.text: Everything was exactly as described The place was clean well-organized and very comfortable Gökhan was very helpful and provided clear instructions and guidance throughout our stay. Considering the price it offers excellent value for money I would definitely recommend this place

Amazing location and amazing host ,
Helped out with late check out , held luggage for me , super accommodating. Location is amazing , astonishing shopping, metro , Taksim .. everything you need in just few steps . i will be back again :) .

Lokasyon olarak gayet iyi bir yerdeydi gezilecek her yere çok yakındı. Kahvaltı imkanının olması bizim için çok iyi oldu. Kaldığımız oda temizdi düzenli olarak temizliği yapılıyordu fakat küçük ve dardı. Bizim için sorun olmadı.
Otelin konumu ve hizmeti çok iyiydi. Metroya yürüme mesafesinde. Çalışanların iletişimi de güler yüzlü ve kibardı.
Supertolles Hotel, Frühstück war ausreichend. es war ein toller Urlaub die metro ist nicht weit entfernt und überall in der nähe auxh supermärkte. danke für den tollen aufenthalt

description: Welcome to your cozy and stylish home in the heart of Taksim!

reviews.text:
I stayed in this apartment for two nights, but I left after the first night because my children and I did not feel safe.
The apartment itself was new and very clean, although it did not have air conditioning. Its location is convenient and close to many attractions in Taksim.
Unfortunately, the biggest problem was safety. The street leading to the apartment was filled with drunk people and people drinking alcohol late at night. There was constant noise, shouting, and women making loud noises in the building during the night. Even more concerning, my children and I were followed by two men, which was a terrifying experience.
There is also no 24-hour reception or on-site assistance. If you need anything, you can only contact the host by SMS.
I do not recommend this apartment for families, especially mothers traveling alone with children. In fact, based on my experience, I would not recommend staying in the Taksim area with children. What should have been a relaxing stay turned into a

Konaklamamız gerçekten harikaydı. Daire son derece temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzeldi. Konumu çok iyiydi, ihtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu. Ev sahibi ilgili, nazik ve iletişimi çok başarılıydı. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederiz, tekrar konaklamayı çok isteriz.
Turker was a great host, responsive and super friendly !! The apartment is well located in a walking distance from Taksim square and as presented in the pictures :)
We had a great stay. Everything was as described and the host was extremely helpful and proactive!
Everything was great. The location is nice on a short walk from everything. The appartment was nice with comfortable beds.

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text:
We had a great stay! We originally booked a different property, but due to an unexpected issue, we contacted this host on the same day. Thankfully, the apartment was available, and the host was very kind and helpful in arranging our stay on such short notice. We really appreciated their quick response and willingness to help.
The location is excellent, with plenty of restaurants, cafés, and shops nearby. The area is lively during both the day and the evening, so there’s always something to do, and it’s easy to get around. The apartment looked exactly like the photos. The bedrooms were clean and comfortable. The only small suggestion would be that the common areas and floors could have been cleaned a little more thoroughly. Other than that, everything met our expectations, and we had a very pleasant stay. Overall, we would definitely recommend this place and would happily stay here again!
Zara Larsson konseri için 4 gün kaldık, zaten konumu dolayısıyla her yere yakın. Ev sahibi de gayet iletişime açık. Ayrıca ev temiz oldukça kullanışlıydı.
Arkadaşlarımla konser için geldik tam bir fiyat performans herşey süperdi bulması kolaydı ve temizdi banyo temiz yataklar temiz teşekkür ederiz birdahakine yine görüşmek üzere

Öncelikle evin konumu mükemmel, Beşiktaşın hareketliliği itibariyle sesten rahatsız olur muyuz diye tereddüt etmiştik ancak eve girdiğimizde dışarıdan izole de olabildik. İlan sahibi Murat beyde gayet yardımcı oldu, kendisine ulaşmak hiç zor olmadı. Misafirperverliğinden dolayı kendisine çok teşekkür ederiz.
Konum ve ev güzeldi. Herşey için teşekkürler

description: Small place but also best in istanbul. Amazing wiev of bosphorus

reviews.text:
Hello!
I stayed here for 5 nights with my brother. You do need to get ready to walk up a few hills, but the view makes it absolutely worth it. The apartment is located in a beautiful little town, with very easily accessible cute coffee shops and nice restaurants. It’s quiet, lively and extremely picturesque. The apartment view is more beautiful than it looks in photos. We spent most of our trip on the balcony. The apartment was clean and perfect. The host was also great, communicative and always helpful. Definitely coming to it again.

Cankat is a great host with great English language skills, willingness to accommodate my needs, and knowledgable and helpful with recommendations and information. I spent nearly a month in this apartment and was very comfortable. The apartment is in a great location with a fantastic Bosphorus view and in a very quiet area with good restaurants nearby and great transportation links to the rest of Istanbul. In 5 minutes I can walk to the bus or dolmus stop to get to Uskudar in another 5 minutes. From Uskudar one can take a ferryboat or the Marmaray. In summary--great location, amazing view, comfortable, quiet and clean living space with a helpful host who lives in the same building.

Great host who posses fluency in English, very communicative and helpful. Surounding of the appartemt are very quiet and chillfull for Istanbul standards, there are many restaurants caffes and bus routs around the place, allowing for easy transportation options. Aparmentent was clean, functional with washing machine and dishwasher and all necceseryy needs including necessery air conditioning. Above all apartment had an amazing view and unique feel. I highly recommend this place and host, for sure it was worth a price.

Konaklamam boyunca kendimi huzurlu ve guvende hissettim. Evin manzarasi fotograftakinden de guzeldi. Terasinda marti seslerini dinlerken Istanbul bogazinin buyuleyici maviligini hayranlikla izleyebilirsiniz. Terasta masa ve sandalyeler var. Evin ici temizdi, esyalar rahat ve yeterliydi. Evin cevresi nezih ve sakindi. Ayni zamanda yerli- yabanci turistlerin ilgilerini ceken bir konumdaydi ve yurume mesafesindeki kafeler hep canliydi. Metro ve deniz ulasimina erisimi kolaydi. Evdeki isitma yeterliydi boylece kisin da bu evde sicacik konaklayabilmek mumkundur. Ciftlere ve yalniz seyahat edenlere bu terasli cati katini tavsiye ederim.
Ev sahibi aile ihtiyaclarimla hizlica ilgilendi, cozumler sundular. Eve girerken ve cikisimda benimle ilgilendiler. Ailenin bana gosterdigi yakinliga cok mutesekkirim. Benimle misafirleri gibi ozenle ilgilendiler. Onlarin sundugu konaklama deneyiminde kendimi guvende ve huzurlu hissettim. Kisisel deneyimim olarak bu konaklama ile harika insanlar tanidim.

To escape Istanbul's bustle, this is the spot! ​The local cafes are wonderful for working, restaurants, bars even clubs are close by, the studio is cozy and perfect for solo travelers or couples. But the star is the view. Pictures don't do it justice; it is much prettier in person and I’ll miss waking up to it. Cankat and his father are absolute gentlemen; his father even picked me up when my taxi got lost. The neighbors are so kind; a lovely couple even helped with my heavy bags during their walk, going completly off route to help me! You feel welcome immediately. The area is quite hilly, which is part of the charm of Kuzguncuk. You likely knew that before booking of course, unlike me, who didn't check and had a midlife crisis upon arrival haha! It was entirely worth the climb for such a sanctuary. You're even greeted by seagulls; one fella knocked on the window to say hi while I worked! Careful though, one stole a slipper haha, so watch what you leave out. Highly recommend this!

description:
ELIS is a rare historic single-family Ottoman house, fully restored to its original charm and thoughtfully renovated with modern comforts. Located on one of the most preserved historic streets in the Blue Mosque (Sultanahmet) area, authentic Istanbul experience.

ELIS remains our home during visits with my wife and two daughters. Filled with generations of memories, we now welcome guests to share its warmth and history. A stay at ELIS is true time travel in the heart of Old City Istanbul.

reviews.text:
Shan was an excellent host and provided a warm and gracious welcome. His personal touch was very appreciated and the instructions for the free transportation from the airport were very clear. Shan also helped us arrange return transportation and baggage storage, which was immensely helpful. In terms of host quality, Shan & Giorgio were a cut above the rest, and made our stay worthwhile.
The home itself was good and matched the photos and description. There was ample space for our family, and the look of the home was both cozy and distinct. The location was very walkable and near a few great restaurants. We did experience a few minor inconveniences with the house itself: the WiFi would go out periodically and the downstairs TV lost functionality as a result, the downstairs shower did not drain well and would fill with water during use, the large bed upstairs felt like it laid at an angle. Even knowing those things, we still would have booked the home.

If you can, book this place right now. With over 120 Airbnb stays in over 50 countries, this place is tied with 1 more for the best I've ever seen. If I could give more than 5 stars I would.
Giorgio and his family are generous to be sharing their home. It is incredible value compared to any hotel in the area and much nicer and cleaner. We were 4 adults and used the 3 bedrooms, which were all great and comfortable.
The photos don't fully do it justice. The house is actually nicer than it looks. We had queen or king size beds in all bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with shower.
This is an old classic Istanbul house which has been renovated to a high standard. The neighbourhood is quiet and safe, and close to most of the most important sights in the old part of Istanbul. We walked nearly everywhere.
If Giorgio's home is available, I would not stay anywhere else in Istanbul next time.

Great communication. If possible, fly into IST and take advantage of the ride set up by the host. We flew into SAW. Finding a ride from the airport was an adventure. (as an aside, taxi at the airport required haggling; Uber pick up was a 15 minute walk from the terminal. We ended up going with one of the semi-official looking (had a vest and a badge of some kind) guys who offered a reasonable price and we were only bold enough to do that because we had a family of 5 adults). Host waited for us to get there. Showed us in and gave detailed instructions. The location was great and right in the middle of Sultanahmet. It’s an old building so sound insulation wasn’t great. Between the laundry machine(5 h to wash and dry, be sure to empty the water trough so the dryer even works, avoid self inflicted noise problems by starting the load early), late night partiers and the early morning calls to prayer, and creaking from upstairs, the downstairs bedroom gets pretty noise.

Stayed at the Eli’s house for 6 nights in Istanbul. Great space accurately pictured, beautifully designed, clean, centrally located, and very comfortable. Traveled with 4 elderly family members and it wasn’t a climb to get to the house & the central heat/water worked very well. Airport transfer was such a great perk and the communicative hosts made the trip so much less stressful. They also supplied 2 Istanbul cards (each can be used for up to 5 ppl) which was super helpful. We’re so grateful to have stayed here and would definitely come back the next time we’re in Istanbul. Highly recommended.

Without a doubt one of our best AirB&B experiences ever! Giorgio went above and beyond as a super host. He was so accommodating as was his lovely brother in law Ziya who welcomed us to the house. The house is better than we could have imagined. So cozy and beautiful. Perfect space for a large group. We spent all our time hanging out in the kitchen/lounge area even though the upstairs bedrooms are so spacious and stylish. Our visit was over a chilly spring weekend and the house was so warm and cozy. Exactly what we were looking forward to after a long day sightseeing. The location of the house is perfect <10minutes to the hippodrome and easy access to Blue Mosque/Hagia Sophia/Topkapi palace. A quick walk to Grand Bazaar. Lots of options for food. And another huge highlight was the Kadirga Hammam just across the park from the house. It was a true historic neighbourhood bath. In no way touristy. It was the best part of our 8 yr old’s trip.
Another consideration, this house is on a tiny lane bookended by parks so a perfect place for kids. There is also a little supermarket around the corner.
Overall this house was an essential highlight of our trip to Istanbul. You really feel steeped in ottoman atmosphere in a wonderful neighbourhood close to everything. Heartfelt thanks to Giorgio and Ziya!

description:
One of the four modern apartments in a fully restored 19th century building.

Located near Galata Tower, close to Istiklal St. and Galata Bridge, within a few minutes walking to Karakoy Tram.

**There is a floor plan of the apartment in the photo stream. We kindly ask our guests to review the plan before booking.**

***Please note that the terrace area is separate and a common space of the building***

reviews.text:
We had a great time at the flat and would thoroughly recommend! we were a little late getting through the airport (long queues at the passport control) but no issues for Zeynep's team and we had a warm welcome and a thorough overview of everything in the flat and the terrace. Was lovely to have some cold water waiting for us in the fridge and a lovely welcome note.
Also worth noting that the shower was excellent!
The location is great for getting to everywhere - we didn't use public transport once and even though the flat is very close to Gelatta Tower - the side street is quite quiet so we weren't disturbed at all. Please note that this flat is on the ground floor - so you only have to use the stairs if you are going up to the terrace - which is beautiful and just perfect for sunsets!
The flat is a little smaller than we expected from the pictures but now a photo of the floor plan has been added so that it is very clear.
Would be more than happy to stay here again if back in Istanbul!

I absolutely loved my stay here! It feels like hotel-level service with the comfort and price point of an Airbnb. The housekeeper, Vahap, was there to help me check in and was really kind and helpful throughout my stay. Mustafa, the host, also responded promptly whenever something came up. The place is located in a central area and a short walk to restaurants etc. The room was clean, comfortable, had all amenities I needed, and the AC was great. It was
Cleaned daily and I received fresh towels etc. I really enjoyed my time and would stay again!

Located next to Galata the ace offer easy access to everything, a good place to start your hike or take public transpirt for any other trip, sightseeing, etc.
The place can be too small for two adults but if you anyway use it only to sleep it is absolutely not a problem. The kitchen offers everything you need to cook and has a very nice table where you can work. The bed is super comfortable, check-in very easy and the building manager Ugur is very helpful friendly and competent person (I never met the host) . If you are super sensitive to noice bring earplugs. Great stylish and clean place to stay in the heart of Istanbul.

This place was unbelievably perfect. Fantastic in every way. The location cannot be beat! Right in the center of Galata by the tower yet quiet off the main paths. The best rooftop view of the old city mosques. Cozy hand-spun robes, a powerful shower, full kitchen amenities, and all LEED certified! Must note that the bed was a little hard and the pillows too big, so felt a bit stiff in the morning. And beyond the control of the host, the power went out a few times, which also shut off the water controlled by electric pump. We were provided with a jug of drinking water for such emergencies for the rest of the week's stay. A delightful hostess cleaned the room each day and made up the bed. Really cannot recommend this place enough. It's perfect. Would love to live in such a place, and when back in beautiful Istanbul will definitely stay here again.

A wonderful home in an incredible area. It's a few steps away from the Galata Tower, and Karakoy is just a 5-7 minute walk away. Lots to do in the area! The apartment was exactly as described - clean, cozy, and with an amazing view from the terrace! The hosts were extremely accommodating and very helpful. Couldn't have asked for a better stay - HIGHLY recommend!!

description:
Hi,
The place is only 7 minutes away from Taksim Square and 3 minutes away from Istiklal street by walking. You can find anything you want that you can find in a proper and well arranged house. There are all kinds of kitchen tools to have a delicious breakfast or a tasty dish at the end of a beautiful Istanbul day. The place and all of the household goods are new. I would like to indicate that I am a teacher and I am ready to host and assist you during your pleasant trip to Istanbul:)

reviews.text:
I hadn't experienced what an AirBnB stay is like or a AirBnB Superhost is like but this first experience ticked all the right boxes for me.
I stayed 2 nights with my wife at Huseyin's place and right from the time I booked and paid, the communication and hospitality level of Huseyin was outclass. He would check on me every now and then, advise on every possible thing and ensured we had a super comfortable stay. So I can assure you that Huseyin definitely is a super host!
As for the place, it was super clean and cosy. The room, kitchen, bathroom and lounge were neat and tidy. Huseyin even provided us with a fan since it was bit hot for our liking!
One thing though I'd like to give a heads up on is the movement at late night in the area. Since the surroundings are a bit rundown in nature, just be wary of potential muggers late night (but thats something you'd find in a lot of metro cities across the world).
Overall, I can't recommend Huseyin as a host enough. Thanks for the hospitality and care, brother!
Regards,
Masood

I recommend to choose this rent. I stayed here for almost two weeks and was pleased by the stay.
The flat is clean and stuffed with all necessary things. Nice kitchen with lots of pots and pans. Wide range of cutlery, all knifes are sharpened. Dishwasher, washing machine. I had all I need.
The location is good, it's two bus stops to Taksim or Sishane metro stations. The main tourist street is 5 min apart. Beyoglu is not the fancy district, there's trash on streets, some residents might seem unfriendly, but during my long stay I had no issues with the neighborhood. On Sundays just over the street from the flat the weekend market takes place. It's a good opportunity to buy cheap fruit or fish or something else.
The host is very kind and helpful. Sometimes I had a feeling that I'm the owner of the flat, cause Hüsein was trying not to disturb me. He doesn't speak English, but we managed the dialog via translate app.
Good rent.

Hüseyin and his brother Bozo are great hosts. They are very friendly, communicative, helpful and easy-going. I was mostly in contact with Bozo and he definitely likes to take an extra step to make people feel welcome. The place is also exactly as advertised: very neat, well taken care of and spacious - all for a pleasant price.
The only downsides for me: As mentioned in another review I also experienced the neighborhood as a bit rundown in general. As I was alone there I did feel less safe so some caution is advised. However, nothing happened. The location is slightly off the city center, but still not tooo far away either: The start of the city center at 5-10 min walking, Galata tower at 20-25 min walking and Hagia Sophia at 60 minutes. But still, various means of transport can be found everywhere. At night it can also be a bit noisy because people like to start outside in this kind of country.
Overal I really liked the place and can recommend Hüseyin and Bozo as hosts.

Strongly recommended place if you want nice, clean, beautiful and comfortable place to stay. Location is perfect, very close to Taksim square. The host is super friendly and helpful, he taught us beautiful places and sightseeings that made our trip wonderful.

I also host on airbnb. I rented Huseyin's house to spend time with my family. The location of the house is very good. Within walking distance to Taksim Square and Istiklal Street. It has everything you will need at home. Especially the kitchen is very useful and you have the materials you want. Hüseyin’s house is very clean and all his belongings are new. He is also very helpful. I definitely recommend it to everyone.

description: Our house is in Arnavutköy. If you want peace in the city you're in the right place, 5 minutes walk to the beach and the center, close to all popular attractions. Bars, cafeteria, restaurants etc.15 minutes to walk to the baby. A perfect apartment suitable for couples. A place with unique nature and scenery where you can wake up with the sounds of a bird, away from the horns of traffic.80 m2.1 bedroom,1 living room, kitchen and bathroom. And there is a private terrace with an excellent sea view.

reviews.text:
We really loved Murat's place. It's exactly the same as pictures and maybe even better. The view from the patio is great for morning coffee, the kitchen had everything we needed for cooking. The bed was big and comfortable, bedroom had lots of storage space for clothes. The owners live downstairs and they have social gatherings especially on weekend nights on their garden downstairs so keep that in mind. Adem was very helpful, we were able to reach him anytime and made our stay easy. We walked to the water everyday, it takes about 15 minutes and Bebek/Arnavutköy area is perfect if you want to stay away from touristy places and enjoy the bosphorus view.
Overall it was a good stay and we would like to stay here again the next time we're in Istanbul. We happily recommend Murat's place.

The apartment is beautifully located with the most amazing view that the pictures don’t quite capture. The kitchen is equipped with new fridge, oven, microwave, stove top, washing machine and dishwasher. You won’t need to ask for anything but if you did Adem is so helpful and will do whatever to make your stay enjoyable. The bed is huge and very comfortable. I loved the week I spent there and I’m planning to go back next year. The village is beautiful and so full of character and you will have many choices of amazing restaurants and cute grocery stores with high quality food. It’s an amazing find so I wouldn’t hesitate to book. I don’t think there are any other bnb places in this location! Also if your concerned about the distance from the city - taxis are so cheap so it’s worth it to stay there away from the noisy city and pollution to relax at night in a peaceful place surrounded by trees and fresh sea air.

One of the cleanest airbnb’s we stayed at. The apartment is well appointed with everything you could need for the stay. All appliances and furniture are new/in very good shape. The terrace and the view are great. The area is generally quiet and the windows keep it well insulated from any noise. The hosts were available for any question. By the way as others have noted, they have frequent social gatherings but we didn’t find it overly loud or intrusive. The parking spot is a bit tricky but there’s other street parking closeby. The location is great if you have a car or you intend to hang out around the waterfront. If it’s your first time in the city or you intend to spend time in business or main touristic areas, it’s less convenient. Overall I would recommend it and look forward to returning

Very happy we chose this villa, so much so, we asked to extend our stay, which we did by an 2 extra days.
Istanbul is a fantastic city to visit, but downtown hotels can be noisy, and we wanted somewhere quiet.
The villa is a short walk up the hill from the very attractive suburb of Arnavotkoy, right on the Bosphorous. Arnavotkoy is an affluent area of greater Istanbul with quaint architecture and many lovely restaurants, and lovely walking along the Bosphorous. The 40T bus, from opposite the ferry jetty takes you to Taksim in 25 -30 minutes, through other attractive suburbs, and very cheap.
The villa was like a little bucolic, rural retreat, verdant, with trees and foliage, spacious with a lovely veranda and a wonderful view down to the Bosphorous. It was so quiet at night with a large bedroom containing the comfiest bed I can remember. Clean, tidy, everything worked, Wi Fi, big TV, nice kitchen, bathroom and lounge. Murat gave good arrival directions. Would definitely book again.

Murat was a great host for his house portion. The adorable parents live down stairs and this place is completely separate entrance and private.
The facilities were excellent and bed was comfy. Nice cosy balcony with a slight view of the Bosphorus.
Recommended if you want to enjoy this area of Istanbul.
However the place is not walkable distance to the waterfront or restaurant friendly places although there are a few in walking distance but recommended to those with a car rental!

description: This is a warm and historical flat with a 310 cm ceiling height and a total area of 110 sqm in the very heart of Istanbul's bohemian neighborhood of Cihangir to let for stays for 2 to 5 people. 10 min walk (700 mt) to reach Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, Orhan Pamuk's Museum of Innocence, Mimar Sinan University Tram stop. Nicely vintage furnished big living and dining room, a fully equipped Kitchen, bathroom, 2 bedrooms (1 queen size bed and 2 beds), a veranda and balcony (where you can smoke).

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Kerem’s apartment and would happily stay here again. The location is excellent—within walking distance of great restaurants, the waterfront, Galataport, and convenient metro connections to many of Istanbul’s most important sights. The Cihangir neighborhood is vibrant, youthful, and full of energy, making it a fun place to explore both day and night.
The apartment itself was spacious, comfortable, clean, and well-equipped with everything we needed for our stay. It felt welcoming and made a great home base for exploring the city.
Kerem was an exceptional host—friendly, responsive, and genuinely helpful throughout our stay. He went above and beyond by offering us transportation to the airport very early in the morning at a very reasonable price. The convenience and peace of mind that provided were greatly appreciated.
We highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul and would gladly stay here again in the future. Thank you, Kerem, for helping ma

Kerem's place was clean, organised and comfortable. His timely responsiveness is the best part of the experience. Galata Tower, Taksim Square and Istaklal Street are the most walkable places without sweat. However, if you plan to take local transport, such as a bus or tram, to go to the Asian side, be ready to climb 300 stairs down and back up. We tried this 10-minute route on our first two days but found it highly challenging to climb back up at the end of the day with an exhausting body and tiring feet. We swap the Bitaxi app for the rest of the trip, which can cost a bit more money but is worth it if you travel in a group of four.
Everything else about this location is excellent: corner stores, cafes, grocery stores, and local restaurants are all a minute or two walk away.
Kerem was out of the city during our trip but he stayed connected and even help us out to find taxi for our ride back to Sabiha Airport.

Was a great experience staying at Kerem's place, in one of the most interesting Istanbul neighbourhoods. Apartment looked like in the pictures and has a great old style vibe, transporting you into a different era. Beds were very comfortable, hot water was running smoothly, wifi worked great mostly in the living room (weaker to no signal in the bedrooms), nights were quiet and loved the fact that were many restaurants around. Area is nice too, although it's hilly around and older or people with disabilities might have difficulties walking, especially when coming from Dolmabahçe side (and harbor) where there are really steep stairs. Kerem also helped us booking a cab and storing our luggage so thank you again!

Very recommended.
Neighbourhood: beautiful, vibrant, full of cafes and restaurants.
Apartment: super clean and smells so good. Beddings and towels also fresh. It is homey and very cozy and spacious.
The bedroom side is so quiet all day long, while in the living room area you can hear the street and cafes below.
The kitchen is fully equipped. There were some snacks, coffee and tea. You also find all you need from house shoes, iron and ironing table, shampoo, make up remover, sanitary products, umbrellas and shoe cleaners!
One downside is that there are no blinds in the bedrooms, so if you can’t sleep in a bright room, make sure to bring a sleeping mask!
The host is super friendly and very responsive. He also let us keep the luggage in the apartment after check-out as our flight was in the evening.
Note for the elderly: the apartment is in an elevated area and public transportation (except for taxis) gets you down the street and you have to walk 15 mins a steep road upwards.

The apartment is very nice, clean, comfortable, quiet, a good size, and in a good neighborhood with plenty of restaurants, shops, and supermarkets. There was everything we needed.
The apartment was well heated for the December chill. It is on the first floor (one floor above the street). The location is about a 10 minute walk to Taksim Square.
Kerem is a great host. He speaks excellent English, and was very helpful during our stay, including picking us up at the airport for a reasonable price.
Kerem's Mother even baked us a cake since we were the first guests.

description:
Step into a bright and thoughtfully designed home in the heart of Istanbul. This second floor one bedroom apartment blends modern comfort with a practical layout, creating a calm and inviting stay within one of the city’s most vibrant neighborhoods. A skylight fills the space with natural daylight during the day and reveals a charming view of the night sky after sunset, adding a unique and cozy atmosphere.

Everything you need for a perfect stay is right at your fingertips!

reviews.text:
High level of comfort!
We stayed in this apartment for few days in december and it was very nice, above our expectations.
Location
In a walking distance from Galata Tower and everything You might need.
Check in, check out and help
Everything was easy and good, no complaints, thank You!
The building
It is a New building with a gym that You can use. But no elevator.
The apartment
Well-equipped apartment, everything is thought out to the smallest detail. Air conditioner (above the entrance door) is big, powerful but not loud, it was able to warm or cool down the entier apartment in few minutes.
The apartment has a wc room next to the kitchen area and bathroom close to dressing room and bed.
The kitchen has everything that is listed in this ad and full set of dishes.
Bed is comfortable, linens and towels are good qulity. There was another set in the closet.
Wifi is good, TV has Netflix.
The apartment is very warm in winter!
The only thing missing there is a shoehorn :)

The apartment was exactly as described and perfect for our 4-day stay. The location is great with plenty to see and do within walking distance, but also close to public transit for other sights. While there are no kitchen amenities provided, the kitchen is well appointed and there is a supermarket nearby. The air conditioner was fantastic, which was great because it was very warm when we visited. The washer & dryer worked well, and we appreciated the laundry detergent. Communication with the host was fantastic - he checked on us and responded to our questions almost instantly. we highly recommend a stay at this AirBnB.

One of the best Airbnb experiences with a host. About the place: the location is perfect for exploring all the tourist areas and going out while being on a fairly quiet street. We were able to walk to Hagia Sophia and Galata Tower. But the host also provides a metro card for you to top up if you wanted to take transportation (cost .40 - .80 US cents for a ride usually).
Its a beautiful, modern, spacious studio (felt more like a 1 bedroom). There is also TWO bathrooms! Great wifi, great gym, and 24 hour security. But this Airbnb deserves the best review for the host: Mete.
I didn't realize that I needed a HES code while traveling to Turkey and Mete took the time to go through the online process to create the code for me and my boyfriend. He made sure that we had this so that we can enter bars, venues, and public transportation. He also helped us call a trustworthy and great taxi driver to get to the airport at 6am. Whenever I would message him about recommendations, he would message back with SO MANY things to choose from. Mete is the best and I highly recommend this airbnb because of him.

We had the most amazing time at NOA apartment exploring Istanbul. The apartment was spotless (I've never stayed in a cleaner place!) and had everything you could possibly need in the apartment. The views from the windows of the street were lovely (we enjoyed watching the cats across the street go down the emergency fire escape stairs!) and it is so close to so many great places in Galata whilst being in a quiet street. It is a short walk to Galata Tower, a reasonable walk to Taksim square and lots of great historical and eating spots nearby. We also were fine to walk to Galata Bridge and across to the historical centre with Aya Sofia/ Topkapi Palace etc. (about a 45-60 Mon walk). The staff servicing the apartment were friendly and the security who helped us check in were great. Communication with the hosts was always excellent - proactive, friendly, and helpful. We thoroughly recommend this place.

The space is excellent. It is full of so much natural light, because of the two skylights and a wall of windows. Yet, you can block out the light whenever you need with the curtains. It looks exactly like it is presented in the photos.
The location is also within walking distance of many different options; bars, restaurants, cafes, etc. Keep in mind in this area there are a bunch of hills to walk up and down to get to things. Which is easy to navigate.
You can access the tram, so if you want to jump on it to go see sights that's easy to do. Having a washing machine in the space is also handy for cleaning clothes if you need it.
One of the best features of this location is the customer service provided by Metehan, which was excellent. My stay in Istanbul was wonderful because of the amazing suggestions for restaurants, museums, parks, and some local sights he provided. It made my trip so easy to navigate and finds the things I truly enjoyed.
I would definitely rent this space again.

description:
The apartment is in the 15 floor , with a perfect view.
Colorful design that makes you feel , relax and comfortable.
it is a perfect place for family members and its only takes one minute walk to go to super market and to restaurants and coffee shops.
And if you are a big fan of shopping you can visit 212 outlet shopping Mall, And Mall of Istanbul the biggest Mall of Turkey, where you can find everything you wish for.

reviews.text:
While the apartment itself is ok in general (except many items being very cheap and in bad condition, dirty sofa and smelly exhaust, absence of many essential things), I would advise travelers to be cautious with the hosts as I never faced such attitude and behavior on airbnb before. In general the host was quite rude, conflict seeking and I found his behavior inadequate.
Given the poor condition of some items (repaired, half broken etc) and some damages in the apartment I would advise travelers to take pictures/video at check in in presence of the host so that he later will not claim you damaged those things. What happened in my case was that he brought the babycot, I started assembling it immediately (i had similar one before) and noticed some damage. Similar to the other damages I sent the picture to the host to avoid any disputes at check out, but he claimed that he just bought it (no proof provided) and that I broke it (i send him picture 5 minutes after he left). Later I found this babycot at 300tl - i.e. again he bought one of the cheapest available.
Also note that upon arrival we had to put aside some items like table as it was poorly repaired and shaking to much - so it was just matter of time for it to break. I reimbursed the host for broken dryer (bought him a better one as I could not find similar to the bad quality he had).
Apart from this, after the check in you do not feel welcome anymore. We were given 2 bath towels with stains and one of them was from some hotel (stolen?). We asked for more as we were 4 guests and we were told that we were given enough!
Also if they promise anything - do not expect it will be done as agreed. The vacuum cleaner was given only after three days instead of couple of hours (guess what, previous one was broken) and it was very weak.
We agreed to check out at particular time - but on the checkout day the host did not respond and did not pick up the phone. Only after I called Airbnb in US (!!!) - he started responding. I lost a lot of time because of that.
Beware.

Apartment is the same as in photos. Location is distant from city center and main places of attraction so if you are into exploring the city, get ready for expensive taxi or quest on how to find public transport routes. Also there are many shops and cafes in a compound where the apartment is located. The apartment is in fair condition, everything works perfect so if you need a place to stay I highly recommend it. Communication with the owner was smooth.

We had a very pleasant 2 weeks stay at this Airbnb. EMMA IS THE BEST!!! Truly the most professional and caring host ! Thank you so much for your quick answers and help during our stay!
The apt is functional and secure in a gated community with 24/7 security. Everything was clean and the AC in the living room is definitely appreciated.
A fan was provided for the bedroom.
The pool and playground are a real +++ as I was traveling with my 3yo son.
Everything is walking distance : Starbucks, few restaurants options, supermarket, pharmacy, taxi stand, etc
It’s only 25min to Florya beach area and 30min to Istanbul airport. Great location!
Would love to come back and discover more!
Thanks again!

The flat was amazing has everything you need apart from a vacuum cleaner and Netflix. It was clean and very warm. However, it is very far from downtown, but it has nice restaurants and coffee shops in the compound. Check in and out was super easy and they accommodated for our late arrival. We will back again in the summer and definitely use Dream Houses for somewhere near the city center.
apartment very well located, everything is nearby .. the host is available and very welcoming. I had a wonderful stay in his apartment

description: Oslo Suite is newly refurbished and features 5 unique suite rooms to match your style and budget. Our spacious New York, Tokyo, Nairobi and Oslo suites are each fully equipped with free WiFi, a TV, a safe box, fresh towels, slippers, a refrigerator and air conditioning, for your convenience.

reviews.text: This apartment is great for short stays. Although the listing says it's suitable for 3 people, it definitely is not. Located in a very central but busy area makes it not the best choice if you plan on staying home during your trip. Also, the noisy nightclub right next to the bedroom window, was quite unfortunate. The apartment was very clean, and heated floors were a welcomed thing. Unfortunately the kitchen was not really usable.

Evin konumu İstiklal’de, Pera’da vakit geçirmek için harika.
Şişhane metro durağının neredeyse dibinde. Metro ile ulaşım değerlendirildiğinde de konum çok çok iyi.
Daireye arabayla geldik ve çok yakınında kapalı güvenlikli bir ücretli otopark var. Kolaylıkla park edip daireye ulaştık.
Daire gayet temizdi. Üşümekten çekinmiştik kiralarken fakat eve geldiğimizde bile ısıtma 22 dereceye setlenmişti ve gayet sıcaktı. Isınma / ısıtma ile ilgili hiçbir kuşkuya gerek yok.
Apartmana girişimiz şifreyle ve çok kolay oldu. Sorunsuz bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık.

We liked staying at Bquest Pera Suites. Location is great, near the Galata Tower and Taksim square. Apt is clean and equipped with everything needed, also towels were changed while staying there. Coskun was very pleasant and helpfull over the whole process. Overall very good place to stay and enjoy the Istanbul.

We had a nice stay in B Guest Pera suites. Apartement is very nice Coskun is very helpful and tried to make our stay as comfortable as possible. Location is quite central with easy access to restaurants, shops and transport...
Place wasn't clean at all. We found dirty dishes and had to shower with used towels. Great location. Horrific experience. I demand a refund of 1 nighr

description: Within walking distance of Nişantaşı and Cevahir Shopping Mall, this comfortable 2+1 apartment offers a unique accommodation experience in the center of Istanbul. The apartment has a stylishly decorated living room, a bedroom with a double bed, a second bedroom with two separate beds, a fully equipped open kitchen and a spacious bathroom. Guests are provided with a washing machine, basic kitchen utensils and clean linens. Ideal for families or couples, this apartment offers a comfortable and pleasant environment.

reviews.text: Metroya ve merkezi konumlara yürüme mesafesinde, eski bir semt için oldukça yeni bir dairede 4 kişilik bir aile olarak konaklamamizi gerçekleştirdik. Temizlik ve düzen olarak yeterli düzeydeydi. Salonda otururken evinizde gibi hissedebilirsiniz. Hareketli bir semt olmasına rağmen, makul derecede sessizdi. Çevrede ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz çoğu şeye yakın bir konumdasiniz. Koray Bey iletişim konusunda oldukça hızlı geri dönüşlerde bulundu. Klimalar ve sıcak suya ulaşım konusunda hiç bir sorun yoktu. Sokak üstünde ücretsiz park yeri bulmak zor olsa da, bir üst sokakta semt için normal ücretin neredeyse yarısı fiyatına kapalı otopark bulunmaktaydı. Genel anlamda memnun kaldığımız, fotoğraflardaki beklentilerimiz ile örtüşen bir deneyim yaşadık. Koray Bey'e bizleri ağırladığı için teşekkür ederiz.
Very nice apartment. Very clean and a good host! I would definitely stay again.

Great location, clean, have all necessary items, and Koray and his team made sure that we have a great time and helped us with a lot of local tips and directions. We had a great stay, highly recommended. We will be back for sure.
Fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi ,rahat sıcak ortamdı
Clean 😭

description: Stay in the heart of Maçka, one of Istanbul's most desirable neighborhoods, perfectly located between Nişantaşı and Beşiktaş. Hosted by Homie Suites, this bright one-bedroom apartment is ideal for both short and long stays. Enjoy seamless self check-in, high-speed Wi-Fi, a fully equipped kitchen, air conditioning, and a comfortable space to unwind after exploring the city. Cafés, restaurants, parks, shopping, and public transportation are all within walking distance.

reviews.text:
Overall great experience. Great location, quite, clean apartment, working AC, lots of space, key furnitures provided including a washer and dryer. Elevator! It is very important in Istanbul. The building looks like it was built for AirBnB purposes and being managed. The hosts were responsive.
Our only improvement point was key elements in the kitchen, such as plates, utensils, etc. They were provided at a minimum and if you are planning to use the kitchen, especially with a young kidit becomes challenging. We suggest upgrading the kitchen and appliances.
Thank you! We would come again.

This one was my third time in this apartment, I really love this place. Perfect location, ATMs, restaurants, stores. My host is really nice and always helped me with the things I needed. Fast wifi, perfectly clean and the neighborhood is really calm, zero noise

We really enjoyed our stay, the apartment had everything we needed and the location was great. The apartment was very clean, water pressure was surprisingly good. The place is quiet and there are blackout curtains so we had good sleep. Mattress was soft but it is a matter of habit. Communication with the host was very pleasant. We will definitely consider this place for our next trips to Istanbul and highly recommend it to other travelers.
Great apartment, as described, clean and modern, WiFi suitable for work - host was great at helping with questions and responding to messages, would recommend!

The apartment is very comfortable and is exactly like the photos in a quite and what seems like a newly built/renovated building . Location is very convenient, near plenty of little food markets restaurants and shops. Self check in was really easy . (Tunc & Erin ) were very helpful and friendly responded within minutes with solutions to whatever concerns or question from food deliveries to translating direction for use of appliances and finding us the nearest locations for Covid testing for our departure. They are such professional Super Hosts !

description: Maslak Aparts Otelcilik Our spacious 2-bedroom suites accommodate up to 4 guests with views overlooking the forest or city. The suites feature king-size & twin beds, a fully equipped kitchen, a private bathroom, and a wide array of amenities that will ensure a comfortable stay.

reviews.text: Amazing apartment with astonishing views and vibrant location. Everything was very good. My family had a great stay there. Also loved the part that there were markets close by to get some groceries and easy accessible to taxi and cars. Thank you so much for hosts and everyone.

Maslak Aparts 1453 is a great residence with daily cleaning service and a staff that is very kind and responsive.
The area is a hub for business and residential areas which can be a good thing but it makes it very heavy traffic to get in and out of.
Good location

صعب جدا حتى وصلنا للمبنى
والموظفين جيدين جداً و ودوديين
مناديل غير متوفرة واغراض الغسالة الا نحن طلبتاها المفروض تكون متوفرة
Yani herhangi bir otelde çok daha iyi fırsatlar çok daha ucuza erişilebilirdi. Yine de ortalama bir konaklama yaşadık.

description: blue mosgue and hagıa sophia is very close to our place ( 10 minutes walk) there is 2 bedroom + living room free wi fi, washing machine, fridge, micro wave, ıron,ıron board,tv, kitchen (full equipment) a.conditioner, heating near apartment markets and restaurants are available First room has one double size bed seconde room has one single size bed And living room has sofa

reviews.text: After a 7-night stay at Taner’s place, I can say it's centrally located but situated downhill. There are also two grocery shops nearby, along with local souvenir shops and restaurants, for added convenience. It's about a 10-15 minute uphill walk to the Blue Mosque, requiring some effort. Taner, a kind, responsive, and punctual host, waited for us for a late check-in and helped to take the luggage upstairs. He promptly assisted us in arranging our airport transfer. This flat is good if you’re fit and happy to walk up and downhill. The furniture is dated, but the apartment was cosy and warm. However, the bedding sheet provided wasn't big enough, and the noisy bed frame disturbed my sleep. Small renovation, particularly in the kitchen and bathroom, is needed. The provided Airbnb pictures were outdated.

We had a great stay at Taners apartment. He was extremely accommodating and let us check in early. He was great at communicating as well. The place itself is located in a great area, near many restaurants and grocery stores. Also right across the street from a currency exchange place so no need to get ripped off at the airport.
15-20 mins walk to the blue mosque, Hagia Sophia and grand bazaar. 30 mins from the spice market. Beds were comfortable for European standards. Cozy living room and kitchen. Hot shower. This place is priced very well and perfect for a quick trip to Istanbul. We were 2 but it would accommodate 3-4 people comfortably. We would book again!

Tanner’s place was just as pictured — what you see is exactly what you get. He’s one of the best hosts I’ve ever encountered — super responsive and helpful. He came within minutes to fix an issue and even replaced the broken dryer with a brand-new one during our stay! I stayed here with my family of four, and overall it was a great value for the price and conveniently located near the main attractions. The only downside was the noise — there was music and activity going on until about 4 a.m. everyday. Otherwise, it was a comfortable and enjoyable stay.

a good located apartment (only 15 min walk to Hagia Sophia) and very close to several supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants, shops (within 5-10 min walk); for those travelling with small kids: there is a small playground close to the aparment; the path to Hagia Sophia is hilly (be aware with stroller); some things can still be improved: the apartment didnt look well maintained as we expected from the photos (also dust under beds and on curtains); we recommend to install some towel hangers in the bathroom; overall, quality-price relationship is okay, it could be better if the mentioned aspects are taken care of.

Taner was a very kind and generous host. He met me at the apartment when I landed from the airport to give me the keys and clear directions on how to get in, which keys to use, etc. The home was cozy and very clean. There is a nice balcony in the second bedroom that I used often to relax, star gaze, etc. The shower drain was clogged one day which made the water collect in the bathroom. I messaged Taner and he responded within a few seconds and came the same day to fix the issue. Taner also met me on my last day at 5am to help me carry my big luggage down the set of stairs and helped me find a taxi. He was incredibly helpful and kind to help me get to the airport on time for my flight. 10/10 recommend - the apartment is very close to all of the major touristy sites and attractions.

description:
The apartment is fully equipped, hotel furniture and comfortable accommodation amenities. The complex is located in a modern and lively area and has all the luxuries a guest could need.
The complex is 4 minutes from Mall 212 and 9 minutes from Mall of Istanbul.
The complex is secure and monitored by cameras.

reviews.text: The place was very clean and comfortable and the host was really helpful and accommodating. I would definitely recommend staying here!

We have arrived around 11 am, and they gave us check in earlier, without paying for it, despite of the fact check in should be around 3 pm. Flat is clean, cozy and very comfortable for staying. We were living there 17 days, and we enjoyed our staying there. Yousuf and his team are rally friendly and before coming have explained everything what we need to bring. Really big thanks for Taj suites for such a hospitality 🙏

I booked this place on 15 May, for period 16 May until 3 June. I talked with the person before to arrive. He asked me few time what time and … When I arrived, the man was kind and he did show me the room. Everything was messy kitchen, living room, bedroom. He taps me to wait little bit. He came after 4-5 min with other man, they checked other apartments and after that THEY TOLD ME THAT THRRE IS MISUNDESTANDING AND I MUST FIND OTHER PLACE AND WILL TRY TO REFUND MY MONEY.
They helped me to find other apartment which was much more expensive and I had to pay cash only, I paid a lot extra commission to get this money in cash. I am not sure if this is just a mistake. It they arrange customers to a friend, to avoid tax with Airbnb or other website. I know it us not pleasure to travel long time , to pay 940 euro for my accommodation and discover that I am
On the street. It is very very big stress. DO NOT TRUST THESE PEOPLE
clean/new apartment near Mall of Istanbul. not the best option if you want something near the city center.

Place was decently clean
Bed is worse thing to sleep on sags and causes back pain
Couches like sitting on wood; the cushions are fired
Area good cause its quite not busy however not inside the apartment. Shouting screaming voices prevent you from proper nights sleep, all night !! They tell you they will solve it with security but in the end nothing changes not built for vacation, we left half way and their customer service is worse it can be. They take every chance not to pay you back but you must be firm and airbnb also helps. Just make sure you document everything. Wouldn’t recommend try someplace else if you can.

description: Our place is located well in the old city center. Room is offering you the best location, comfortable and safe stay. Room is fully furnished. It has privet bathroom,mini fridge,Tv, Air condition. Also wi-fi is provided free of charge. All major places 5-10 minutes walking distance. Tramway and all public transportation is walking distance. Our apartment is faced to the historical old city walls and marmara sea. We will be able to helping you to make your stay better.

reviews.text: Very pleased. Shaban arrange a taxi from the airport and back to it for a very reasonable price. The apartment room is in a very quiet area, close to Sultanhamet, which can be reached by 2 separate easy walks. From there, trams and metro are available to explore the city. Shaban and his colleague were friendly and helpful. Very responsive and efficient too. Excellent. The room was clean, tidy and as I expected. Warm, good bedding, TV, and a shower ensuite. After being out in Istanbul, Sultanhamet is a great 'landmark' to head for and Shaban's building is a couple of minutes walk from one edge of the main Sultanhamet Park area. Overall, I enjoyed my stay very much. Privacy, room cleaning if I wanted it and a feeling of security too. Recommended!!!!

This place was even better than expected. The location is perfect, the sea view is excellent and is close to many tourist attractions by foot. The host was very friendly, kind and helpful, always smiling. The room had everything we needed and it was clean - air conditioner, hairdryer, TV, a comfy bed and towels. As 2 girls travelling I recommend you this airbnb, is safe and the price is more than fair. Thank you Shaban!

Fiyat/kalite performansı 5 yıldızı hak ediyor. Shaban da gayet nazik ve ilgili bir ev sahibi. İlk 3 gece tek başıma, son gece ise eşimle birlikte kaldım. Bir kadın olarak gayet güvende hissettim kendimi. Manzarası da çok güzel. Uygun bütçeli, güvenli, temiz, sakin ama aynı zamanda Sultanahmet meydana yakın bir yer arayanlara tavsiye ederim.

You get exactly what you pay for. Great location near the mosques walking distance from restaurants and 10 minute walk away from T1 tram station. Friendly host, easy to communicate with. Would stay here again

The room is very comfortable and in a very good location. All relevant sights can be reached on foot and there is also a tram stop only a few minutes away. Shaban is very friendly and helpful. Great host!

description:
This stylish apartment is ideally located in a quiet street of the highly sought after neighborhood Suadiye.

It is on the third floor of a new building with elevator and private parking.

reviews.text: Helga was very responsive, kind and understanding with every flexibility we needed. The airbnb itself is exactly how it looks on the photos. The apartment is very new modern clean and bright. It has all the required basic amenities and they are fully functional. As a Turkish person I can endorse that the location is so close to Baghdat street and transportations like minibuses and Marmaray. My guests were very pleased with their stay.

Cozy, comfortable and bright 2-bedroom apartment.
Clean, well equipped, it had comfortable bed, it was warm.
Had a real beautiful plant in the living room.
Even had a yoga mat and a block👍
Area was a bit quiet, but supermarkets, cafes and train station is easy to reach.
Helga was very responsive and helpful!

Thank you for mrs helga for the beautiful apertment everything i need it was there comfort place and nice neighbor i feel in home and there every things you need bakery, supermarket and restaurant beautiful neighborhood and it is near bagdad street and there's elevator in the building the host was very helpful and friendly

I can't say enough about our stay at Helga's place! Fantastic hosts with great communication throughout the whole check in and stay. The flat was impeccably clean and is on a quiet street away from noise but just a short walk away from many great restaurants, shops, public transport, coffee shops,etc. Filtre and Cofyrup coffee shops are both highly recommend. Would definitely recommend Helga's place and would for sure stay again when we return to this awesome city!

1 haftalık konaklamamız Helga’nın evinde çok rahat ve konforlu geçti. Daire tam olarak tanımlamalarda ve fotoğraflarda anlatıldığı şekildeydi. Dairenin araç park olanakları çok büyük rahatlık sağladı. Kendi kendine giriş ve çıkış çok rahattı. Girişte yaşadığımız ufak internet sorunu, saat geç olmasına rağmen Helga tarafından hemen çözümlendi. Kendisiyle iletişim çok rahat ve kolaydı. Güzel konaklama için çok teşekkürler, tekrar konaklamaktan memnuniyet duyarız.

description:
Close to the hospital, close to the school, close to the market, close to the street
