Kozyatağı-Fındıklı (19 FK): There is a bus every 20 minutes. It takes 10 minutes. Maltepe Center (133F): There is a bus.

reviews.text: Ev sahibi hızlı iletişime geçti ve ihtiyacımız olan tüm bilgileri bize sundu. Evin konumu rahatlıkla ulaşabilen bir yerde, kapalı otoparkının ve yakında marketin olması da avantajlıydı. Evin güzel bir şehir manzarası var, mutfağında ihtiyacımızın olduğu tüm eşyalar mevcuttu ve ısınma çok iyiydi. Teşekkürler Pınar Hanım.

Ev genel olarak kullanışlı ve temizdi. Giriş çıkışlarda ve otopark konusunda çok yardımcı oldular. Mutfak ve banyo gereçleri olarak da temiz ve yeterliydi. Her şeyden fazla fazla koyulmuştu. Evin ısıtması da çok başarılıydı, petekler ayarlanabilir, yükselttiğinizde gerçekten çok sıcak oluyor; klimaya ihtiyaç duymadık. Bölgede tavsiye edebileceğim yerlerden biri. Sadece balkon olmadığı ve sigara içilebilir olduğu için eve sinmiş bir koku vardı; dışardan girildiğinde rahatsız edecek derecedeydi. Buna da yapılabilecek çok bir şey yok, sigara içilebilir olduğu belirtilmiş zaten.
Awesome place, everything is as described and pictured. Mehmet was a great host, very helpful and very friendly. Will visit again definitely. Thank you my friend. 😊 🙏

Yücel is a great host, he was always available for any questions we had. He even picked us up at the hotel in the first day of our stay!
The apartment itself is amazing, we had everything we need and even more (like a dishwasher and awesome view from 21st floor). Two supermarkets are in the same building, very good bakery is down the street and bus stop is in 5 min walking distance. We highly recommend this lovely apartment as a place to stay!

The apartment was exactly as advertised, the check-in and check-out process was easy, the apartment was clean and everything was working fine. Overall I had a great stay. I would like to thank the host for their hospitality and recommend this listing for everyone.

description:
This exclusive newly refurbished Flat is located in Nisantasi, near Abdi Ipekci Street, at the very High End of Istanbul. High end Shops, Haute Couture Boutiques, Cafes, Bars and Restaurants are available within minutes of walking distance.
The flat is 160 m2 and consists of 3 Bedrooms(all with AC), a Large living room, Kitchen, 2 bathrooms (one En suite) plus a toilet.
The flat has a small french balcony at the rear.

reviews.text:
One of the best airbnb for families and friends. Great location with anything within 10 min walk. The host is a real gentleman who was always available for any help.
Super clean and organized
Air conditioning in all the rooms
Secure door and windows
Elevators with only a few steps in the front
Fully loaded kitchen with stove and cocking stuff
Great location with restaurants and store nearby (less than 10 min walk)
This location is a great choice for younger and senior families and folks.
The host is also living in the building so you can expect a safe and welcoming environment.
My parents and I had 10 out of 10 experiences and will recommend it to anyone who are looking for safe, clean and comfortable spaces.
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We absolutely loved this apartment, perfect for a family/group, very clean, located in the best street of Nisantasi, elevator is available, fully furnished kitchen, all the pubs and restaurants are around, little pastry shop is located next door so we were able to have fresh pastry and bread every morning, Jebag is a wonderful host, very attentive , he speaks perfect English, he helped us with the airport pick up, this apartment is highly recommended and definitely worth the price . I shall mention Jebag is staying in the same building which makes it much easier for the guests to get in touch

This is an excellent apartment. Spacious, clean and has everything you need to stay comfortable. Everything in it was functioning properly. We arrived in mid December and the apartment was warm and nice and hot water was available anytime.
Spacious and well equipped kitchen, large living and dining room, large master bedroom that has its own bathroom.
The neighborhood is incredible with many upscale restaurants, bars, pastry shops and gift shops to choose from. The City’s mall and a large supermarket are only few blocks away. I can’t describe how lovely and convenient that area is.
The owner is a very respectful, caring and a true gentleman who was very helpful and accommodating and made us feel very welcomed and I greatly appreciate it.
I definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting İstanbul , if you want to stay in Nişantaşı area then look no further.

A Perfect Stay!
Our experience at this Airbnb was truly outstanding—one of the best stays we've ever had. We honestly felt at home from the moment we arrived.
The apartment is immaculately clean and very well-kept. The bathrooms were spotless, the bed sheets were fresh, and there were plenty of towels and everything we needed in the kitchen.
The location is absolutely perfect, situated in a beautiful, walkable neighborhood with an abundance of amazing bars, restaurants, and coffee shops right at your doorstep. It was incredibly convenient and made exploring a joy.
Beyond the beautiful space, what made this stay so special was the host, Jebag. He was incredibly helpful and proactive. He was always quick to respond and arranged a private car from the airport for us, which made our arrival seamless. His recommendations were always spot-on, and his communication was excellent throughout our stay.
Every person in our group was thoroughly impressed and would highly recommend this place.

Perfect apartment in Istanbul! The location couldn’t be better – super central, close to everything, yet quiet and comfortable. The place is huge, spacious, exactly as described, maybe even better in person. Everything was clean, tidy, and fully equipped.
The host – absolutely amazing! Super friendly, welcomed us like friends, gave us great local tips for food, sightseeing, and hidden gems around the city. Communication was easy and fast.
If you’re coming to Istanbul, this is the place you want to stay in. Totally recommend it! 💯

description:
Flat is located in downtown and heart of istanbul .it takes 5 min
to sea , galata tower , istiklal alley and to close taksim square.
There is many popular and beautiful bar and cafe , restaurant ( you can go there by walk )
In Istanbul it is much more easier to use public transportation like metro and bus ( around 5 min or less to metro and bus station)

reviews.text: Sadaf was really friendly, helpful and responsive. The house was very clean, organized and as described. The only problem I had was the shower, it was hard to manage and the water would get cold all of a sudden, that wasn’t the best thing since it’s winter. The location is good, supermarket is like 3 mins away, transportation is close, Galata tower is close, bars and restaurants everywhere. Since the house is close to a lot of electrical shops, sometimes it would be loud outside from very early in the morning. But overall, I enjoyed my stay a lot. If I ever come back to Istanbul, I would definitely book it again!

Really enjoyed my stay here! Sadaf was really helpful and always responded right away when I needed a question answered. The place looked just like the photos and was really cozy. The location was also amazing. You’re literally a couple blocks away from Galata tower and you’re within walking distance from a lot of really good cafes and restaurants. You’re also pretty close to the subway station, just like a 5-10 minute walk. You’re also within walking distance of other cool areas like karakoy, taksim, and istiklal street. I had a little trouble with the wifi connection while I was there, but other than that it was a perfect spot for me while I was in Istanbul!

The location is very good - all public transport - metro, buses, tram and port is nearby. The host is very friendly and responds quickly. Everything is as in the photos. We're very pleased with the check-in.
Minus is the noise from the shops from the street but if you get up early this will not be issue. Also there is no ventilation in the bathroom and the air in the room is humid. Overall good ration price/ quality.

The flat has a great location in the heart of Istanbul which makes it very convenient to just walk around without having to use public transport or taxis.
However, we thought that the flat was overall not clean enough.
When we arrived, the bed had no sheets, there was no toilet paper, no towels... we texted Sadaf about it and the next day her mom brought what we asked for (bed sheets tho seemed very old).
It was written in the appartement description that there is a cloth dryer but there was no. Moreover, there was no soap to use in the washing machine and when I asked Sadaf she said that it was not on her to provide some. We were traveling by plane back and forth and for obvious reasons it was not worth it for us to buy some to use the machine only once. We believe providing this product should be included, otherwise it shouldn’t be mentioned that there is a washing machine ready to use.
In addition, the wifi connexion is not good at all, this place is definitely not for someone who would like to work remote for instance.
Another thing, we’ve been told to not change the temperature of the AC, which was set on 20 degrees. We ignore the reasons why but we would have enjoyed to be able to change it. Last but not least, the surrounding of the apartment is noisy in the morning due to the people working at the shops right under the windows, this however didn’t bother us that much since we were waking up early to go visit the city, just saying for the people who would plan to rest.
As a conclusion, our experience in this flat could have been better. The only good thing we see about it is again it’s great location.
Clem & Nes

Sadaf was a very welcoming and helpful host. The cute apartment is well located. It matched the pictures. And we found it clean and tidy. Little comment on the air conditioning being a bit noisy at the time of our travel.

description: A unique apartment in a lively area surrounded by supermarkets ,restaurants,hospitals, and shopping malls. Next to Şişli with excellent public transport connections, you can easily reach Istanbul’s historic landmarks. Taksim is just 15 minutes, Sultanahmet 20 minutes, and Istanbul Airport 30 minutes away. You can also easily access Cevahir Shopping Mall within minutes. The building offers 24/7 security, free indoor car parking, Gym. A safe and welcoming place for both business and leisure stays.

reviews.text: My family and I (9 adults in total) stayed at Sinan's place for a week in August 2023. Sinan is a great host and was very responsive and flexible throughout the booking process until the end of our stay. The apartment is nice and everything was very clean when we arrived. There are 3 bedrooms with 2 beds in each, one foldable bed, and a few floor mattresses, as well as couches to sleep on. And 2 spacious bathrooms. The living room and rooms appear larger in the photos than they actually are, and staying 9 full-grown people for a week here, turned out to be a little cramped. But otherwise, everything was great! There are a few smaller supermarkets and small restaurants/cafes close by, but you can take the metrobus to more busy areas very easily (make sure you get a transport card). The Metrobus station is a 5 mins walk from the apartment, and the bus stops are only an 8 mins walk. Can definitely recommend Sinan's place!

I had a great experience staying at this apartment. The place was exactly as described clean, cozy, and well-equipped with everything I needed. The location was perfect, close to public transportation. Communication with the host was smooth and friendly throughout the stay. They were very helpful and responsive whenever I had a question. I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting the area, and I’d love to stay here again in the future!

Mr Sinan is a super host, fast response to all of my requests like replacing a kettle, hairdryer or clean bed sheets. The place was very clean and exactly the same as the pictures.
The neighborhood was ok, not the best in town in terms of access to shopping malls or metro.

As it was my first experience with Airbnb I would like to start by Mr.Sinan, a real gentleman with all what it means , super kind and responsible ,
my stay was for 5 nights with my wife kids age (17,16,14,3 years old ) on each and other day I was receiving a msg from him asking if I’m in need of anything , a big 👍 to him for his care ( Thank you sir ).
2nd the flat and the building is exactly as in the pictures super clean and shiny ,
Hot water ,
central heating system for the floor ,
Fastest internet speed tested in Istanbul, safe parking for our car under the building with a security guy at the reception all the time with CCTV monitoring ,
I highly will recommend giving Mr.Sinan a chance to treat you as good as he did with me. Good luck

Staying at Sinan’s place was an amazing experience. The house was extremely clean, well-kept, and everything worked exactly as described. The location was perfect and made my trip even better.
Getting a nice place in Turkey is one thing, but having a host who is always available, attentive, and willing to help in any situation is something else. Sinan truly went above and beyond to make sure I was comfortable and satisfied throughout my stay. I really appreciate his kindness and professionalism.
Highly recommended — thank you, Sinan

description:
A peaceful escape house in the city but away from all the commotion of the city. Whether you're inside or out without getting stuck between four walls.
All seasons are beautiful. Quiet, calm, peaceful…Whether you work from home or read your book, sip your coffee. Have your cat sit on your lap, maybe your dog is outside getting some air, and you're out one step, and you're out in nature.

The kitchen has everything you need. You made the cake and the house is a warm nest that smells good. You're fun and safe for kids. Heating and hot water

reviews.text:
Meltem Hanımla Bülent Beyi önceki konaklamalarımdan tanıyorum ve bu güvenle yine bu evi tuttum.
Temizlik konusunda çok titizler. Ev çok rahat ve konum olarak sessiz, sakin bir yerde. Bahçesi olması ayrı bir avantaj. Mutfak tam donanımlı. Zincir marketlerin topluca bulunduğu yere 8-10 dakika yürüme mesafesinde. Ulaşım olanakları güzel. Internet hızı gayet iyi.
Herkese tavsiye ederim.

Çok tatlı kullanışlı ve rahat bir evdi. Özellikle mutfakta ihtiyaç duyabileceğiniz her şey özenle düşünülmüş. Uzun süreli bile kalınabilecek temiz ve konforlu bir yer.Ev konumu gereği oldukça sakin bir sokakta, sessizlikte dinlenebiliyorsunuz.
Meltem Hanım kibar ve anlayışlı bir ev sahibi. Kendisine ve Bülent Bey'e teşekkür ederiz.

The host is very welcoming. The house is cute, and the facilities are in good working order. She greeted us and got us the basic stuff such as toiletries etc and also gave us a ride around to show the neighborhood and the stores nearby. She was also very understanding and flexible with the check out, which was very helpful for us. The only thing that needs improving is the cleanliness, especially the cleaning appliances. Also, the location of the airbnb is not very central so it might be inconvenient for some travelers.

The host are heartwarming. They always ask about our conditions like the house also the wifi. They help us about the house utilities, and bring some stuff that we need. The internet connection (wifi) was pretty good for 3 people, but sometimes they aren't work. Everything is good. The house are clean and neat. I love the garden. Thank you for hosting us.

The host was very responsive. Instructions to get into flat were very explanatory and helpful. It was not important for me, but it may be a good idea to update the photos which were left from previous year's New Year Eve.

description:
Our apartment, located in a central location, was designed to ensure the comfort of our guests. The apartment has only your own bathroom, kitchen and kitchen equipment.
Metro and tram are located 300 meters from Marmaray.
It is within walking distance to all historical and touristic places. It is close to historical places such as Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Topkapi Palace Museum and Laleli Bazaar. Also, Yenikapı, where the sea buses are located, is within walking distance.

reviews.text: First thing to note is that the apartment is at the top of three very steep and uneven flights of stairs. The apartment is smaller than it appears in photos and a bit older. Bathroom feels a bit dated. The location is good and in a quiet back street. Excellent Uygur restaurant nearby. Wifi did not work when I arrived - password was rejected. Host did not respond when I asked for a visit so I hunted down the router in the corridor, disconnected power and password was accepted when I reconnected. Even then speed was variable and quite slow sometimes.

ev sahibinin iletisimi guzel hizli cevaplar veriyor o konuda sıkıntı yasamazsiniz fakat bazi eksikler var. oncelikle evde terlik olmamasi beklemedigimiz bir seydi bunun sikintisini tuvalete gittigimizde yasadik ve genel olarak parkeler bize cok temiz gelmediginden dolayi evin icinde dolasirken pek rahat hissetmedik. onun disinda tuvalet kagidinin, havlularin yetsiz olmasi bizi pek memnun etmedi. mutfakta isiticinin eski pusku bir sey olmasi calistirma tusunun yerinden cikar gibi olmasi ve isi kapasitesinin az olmasi hos olmadi. evin ici genel olarak ilikti, sicak degildi sabah uyandigimizda usumus halde uyandik. klima yeterli degil cok az ufluyor ve istenilen sıcaklığa cikartmiyor. wifi cok yavas kullanilabilir gibi degil. bunlarin disinda yenikapi metroya oldukca yakin ve cevrede bulabilceginiz yemek yerleri oldukca fazla. genel olarak fiyat performans denebilir ama soyledigim eksikler kapatilirse musteriye daha iyi bir hizmet sağlanmış olur.

Öncelikle bu fiyata bu performans oldukça iyi. Lokasyon da Yenikapı metrosuna çok yakın o yönden artı ama sokak biraz tekinsiz gibi geldi. Oda da temiz görünüyordu mutfak kısmı da yeterince iyiydi. Oda geniş ve ferahtı. Tuvalet temizdi ama biraz küçüktü sıcak su vardı. Biz en çok sıkıntıyı odada terlik olmamasından dolayı çektik odanın içinde sürekli ayakkabı ile gezmek duş sonrası ayakkabıyı giymek rahatsız etti. Onun dışında her şey güzeldi diyebilirim bu fiyata tavsiye edebilirim.

Ali, is a friendly host, he is always responsive. The place was as discribed in the photos. The cleanliness was perfect. The only problem for me was the internet quality: lots of instability and breakdowns. The host insures that it is not in his hand, and it is due to the company that establish internet. I recommend this place.
Clean comfortable apartment, good location. Attractions within walking distance. Responsive host. I recommend!

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.

reviews.text: Basement room(in ruins), a bit wierd balcony=patio(green photos), furniture not so new as on photo. Nice, comfortable shower. All clean. Good for short cheap stay right in center. Pleasent communication.

Bu konaklama şimdiye kadar kaldığım favorilerimden biri oldu. Konumu mükemmel, çevredeki birçok yere yürüyerek kolayca ulaşabildik. Ev çok temiz, düzenli ve fotoğraflardakiyle tamamen uyumluydu.
Ev sahibi son derece ilgili, nazik ve iletişimi çok hızlıydı. Her konuda yardımcı oldu ve kendimizi evimizde hissetmemizi sağladı. Konaklamamız boyunca hiçbir sorun yaşamadık.
Harika konumu, konforlu ortamı ve misafirperver ev sahibi sayesinde unutulmaz bir deneyim yaşadık. Kesinlikle tekrar kalmak isterim ve herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim. Teşekkürler!

The place is an ok value for your money if you just need a place to sleep. Very much so just to sleep.

Staying at Vera’s listing was an absolute delight! Despite the bustling energy of Istiklal Street, the location was a paradise for foodies and shoppers alike. Surprisingly, I still managed to enjoy peaceful nights of sleep thanks to the cozy comfort of the apartment.
True to the pictures, the accommodation was as comfortable as it appeared, and the provided amenities exceeded my expectations. The daily room cleaning service was a lovely touch, ensuring a consistently pleasant environment. While the shower occasionally clogged up, it didn’t hinder my ability to enjoy refreshing, warm showers every day. Overall, my experience was fantastic, and I highly recommend Vera’s place to anyone visiting Istanbul.

Amazing place! I really enjoyed my stay here. The location is excellent — right on İstiklal Caddesi and perfectly positioned between both Taksim Square and Galata. The apartment itself was clean, spacious, and perfect for two people. It’s well‑equipped with all the necessities, which makes it ideal for a longer stay. I can’t fault the apartment at all, and the lift access is a huge bonus if you’re staying on the higher floors.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul! Everything was exactly as described—clean, comfortable, and thoughtfully equipped. The location was excellent, with easy access to restaurants, cafés, public transportation, and many of the city’s top attractions.
The highlight of our stay was the incredible view from the kitchen. Seeing the beautiful Galata Tower right from the kitchen window made every morning and evening feel special. It was truly one of the most memorable parts of our experience.
The host was friendly, responsive, and always willing to help. We felt very welcome throughout our stay and would happily choose this apartment again on our next trip to Istanbul. Highly recommended!

Pros — communicate host with easy check in, great location with lots to do and see, close to most things and accessible. All three bedrooms had their own air conditioning unit which was great. The area is a bit hilly so would not recommend for anyone with mobility issues. Everything is open to late, but fortunately there were no noise issues when sleeping. Area is quite touristy so as expected, things cost 2-3x more in this area and there are a lot of people trying to rip off tourists
Cons — water heater broke down on second night and host came by to fix it and it was fixed in a few minutes. broke again a few nights later and this time it took hours and hours to fix it again. sounds like host knew the water heater was old and had issues so ideally should have addressed the heater issue before renting the place out.
both inside and outside the place in the hallway with stairs (no elevator) are relatively poorly lit.

We had a great stay at this apartment. It matched the pictures exactly and was very clean. Great views of the Galata Tower. Check-in and communication was easy. Wifi was fast, water pressure was excellent. Heating worked well. The beds were comfortable. Some noise and music from the streets is unavoidable in this area but it did not bother us. There is relatively little common space in which to congregate except for a dining table with chairs and the stools in the kitchen, but we found this sufficient. Highly recommended.

The location was very convenient. The restaurant downstairs had wonderful food/coffee. The host didn’t greet us instead she send someone to open the door.
Pros-location, description of the apartment, great AC in all rooms
Cons-there should be check list of how to operate washer/dryer as it is not in English, checkout process as I had to text host where to leave keys as our flight was in middle of the night( I could have asked host each time but we are here for vacation), where to throw trash, very noisy at night (outside traffic, neighbors noise even at 1am, no elevator so you have to take several stairs (something that can be noted incase mobility issues), pest control(there were ants even though we didn’t cook), the street is on a hilly area(not host fault)

The place is misrepresented in a few ways. The living room is not a living room, it is the tiniest hall way, which makes it hard to move around as the dining table feels larger than the room itself. The wooden floors are extremely squeaky and loud. We could also hear the neighbours upstairs all the time.
Another misrepresentation is the photos of the TV screens in the bedrooms, they have managed to find the oldest and cheapest screens that require you to navigate using a computer curser, which then plays an audio quality of a speaker used in a cheap toy.
Overall wouldn’t recommend staying with this host.

reviews.text: Absolutely wonderful all around! Tons of walkable restaurants. Less than 10 minutes by tram to Sultan Ahmet Mosque and Ayasofya. Location is perfect and the area is very safe! Parking is a little tricky if you’re planning on renting a car: you may need to use one of several nearby “otoparks” if you try to park during the daytime. There’s plenty of available street parking in the evening though. Meeting the host’s lovely father was definitely a plus too; he went above and beyond to make us feel right at home and was very responsive to any questions we had. Would definitely recommend 10/10!

Good value for money. Air conditioning was not working properly, otherwise everything else was as advertised. Location is decent - nice cafe down the road and a reasonably busy restaurant/market strip within 10m walk.

reviews.text: An exciting location. Extremely vibrant and fun. The apartment was nice and warm and kept fairly clean. The host (Hasan) was extremely friendly and ensured our stay was as comfortable as possible. Parking fir a vehicle is a bit challanging, but not impossible. Plenty of Otopark's available nearby and sometimes even street parking can be found.

We had a fantastic stay at Hasan’s place! The apartment was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location was great and everything went smoothly. Thank you Hasan for being a wonderful host. We would definitely love to stay here again in the future and highly recommend it to everyone!

Firstly I like to express my gratitude to Hasan. He was great at communication, always replying quickly. extremely helpful - he even offered his hotel (located nearby) to store our luggage for a couple of days when we left IST to other places.
Unfortunately when we arrived, Hasan mentioned that the original unit’s heating had a problem+leaky ceiling, hence he paid for a replacement room nearby. The room was in a very unsatisfactory condition which was made known to Hasan late at night when we finally came back and settled down.

description:
Our apartment is thoughtfully designed to make you feel right at home. From comfortable beds and fresh linens to a fully-equipped kitchen, LED TV, air conditioner, washing machine, dishwasher, oven and high-speed Wi-Fi, we've thought of everything to ensure your stay is comfortable and enjoyable.

reviews.text:
Sedef and Mustafa are very attentive hosts. They really know how to make one feel like at home.
I checked in quite late, but Mustafa was waiting for me without a word of complaint about my delay.
The house is not too large, but very cosy and has everything you might need; as I was a sole traveler, it was more than enough. I believe 3-4 people can stay in a very comfortable way.
I think the place is brand new (or maintained in an extremely good way) as there was not even a scratch or a particle of dust 😊
All necessary equipment was available and the location is very convenient, just a minute to Bagdad street and a few minutes walking to the sea side. There is a shop nearby, as well quite a good choice of restaurants and the train station is just around the corner.
I will surely stay at this place too next time I come to Istanbul

I have stayed in Sedef 's and Mustafa's place with my family for 8 nights in April 2023. We absolutely loved it! The apartment is new and very central. It was spotless clean. Many restaurants, markets, butchers, fish monger, bakery, groceries, coffee shops in walking distance (Evce is my favourite to grab home made snacks!). it's a very local neighborhood despite being central and accessible. The communication was very good and Mustafa was very helpful from the check in to check out, I would definitely stay here again .

Excellent modern apartment in a new house with all the amenities. It was a pleasure to live, it was nice to come back to the apartment after sightseeing in the city. The house is clean and comfortable. Especially want to highlight the excellent bed in which you sleep like a baby. Responsive and friendly owner. You won't find a better apartment!)

The flat was really nice and Mustafa was helpful and responsive to our msgs. The air conditioning was broken on the first night which Mustafa chased and fixed it the day after. I’m giving one star less as the linens were not the best quality really and they were bubbly, same with the towels that were a bit knackered. There was no salt, pepper or oil or tea which usually you can find in airbnbs. The shampoo bottle was finished but again Mustafa replaced it as soon as we texted him. There was turkish coffee and welcoming bottles of water which was nice.
The shower wasn’t draining properly as it was clogged with previous guests hair which we needed to sort it ourselves.
Maybe if the linens and the towels were higher quality, and the shower drain was clean i would have given 5 stars, cause the rests are minor things.

It's a very nice apartment, comfortable quiet and clean. Our host Mustafa was very friendly and accommodating. We enjoyed our stay here very much. I would recommend this place and this host and would definitely stay again.

reviews.text: Great stay! The apartment was clean, well-located, and just as described. Muhammed was super helpful and friendly, made everything smooth. Would definitely book again!

Place was pretty average. Room was nice. The balcony was alright, with a pretty view however the door to the balcony was not locking properly. A bit of a cold air comes from under the door and can be opened from the outside. Very unsafe.

reviews.text: Bedirhan’s place was cozy and small. Perfect for two people. He was very helpful throughout the stay. Location was great. Easy access to bus and taxis. He also gave us two free cleaning service during our stay as I was there for three weeks. Our AC was dripping water on the first day but he fixed that right away. Over all we had a great comfortable stay at Bedirhan’s place.

Great stay. The place was spotless, and in a good neighborhood with everything you need nearby. Bedirhan and his team were always just a quick text away, and extremely helpful. The bathroom & shower were particularly nice, very luxurious. Comfortable bed. And also has some really good books inside the apartment.

The property exceeded my expectations. It was an exceptionally quiet apartment located in a safe area. Finding it and checking in were both seamless processes. The apartment itself was impeccably clean, equipped with all the necessary amenities. Its location was perfect, being close to numerous restaurants and shops while maintaining a serene and tranquil atmosphere. Bedirhan, the host, proved to be highly responsible and readily available to assist with any inquiries or concerns. I would definetely rate him as a superhost. I would unquestionably choose to book this property again when I return.

This apartment was cosy, modern, very clean and perfect for a short stay. As soon as you enter, you feel at home and the neighbourhood is peaceful. You also have all the amenities to go about daily life with ease. Not to mention it's on the first floor.
An issue regarding the tourism police doing an unexpected check up on the apartment to make sure it's in order came up, which the host had no control over.
However, Bedirhan was very helpful and accommodating, upgrading me to another one of his apartments even closer to Ortaköy Square and personally helping me check-in.
Regarding Bedirhan, he is very friendly, hospitable and pleasant to connect with, making your stay even smoother and more comfortable.
After staying at a few Airbnb places in Istanbul previously, I highly recommend staying at this apartment or at another one of Bedirhan's places. Your trip to Istanbul will be even more enjoyable.

We liked everything very much, the apartment is small, but very cozy and well planned. Located in a good location surrounded by restaurants and large shopping centers within walking distance. description:

You step out onto Abdi İpekçi Caddesi: Istanbul's designer boutiques, cafes and restaurants are on your street. Osmanbey Metro 6 min on foot with a direct line to IST Airport; Taksim 10 min.

2 queen beds + 2 sofa beds, full kitchen, fiber WiFi, dedicated workspace, washer, elevator. Flexible cancellation.

reviews.text: We stayed for 3 weeks and had a lovely time. It’s in the middle of downtown so all the restaurants and stores are within walking distance. There is a good view. Grocery store is down the corner, the neighborhood is friendly. Weekly house cleaning and laundry services was also a bonus. only downside might be that the lift can get quite noisy and might be annoying at night, otherwise, great place!
It’s in a perfect location, easy access to every part of Istanbul . Comfortable and clean
The host was extremely helpful and responsive all the day they offered cleaning for free. Very helpful
We had a great stay! Can was super helpful and understanding! Was very responsive and always replied quickly! The apartment was very cozy and the location was great !

If you are looking for an on spot location here is it. The building is located in an area that all what you need is there. Cemil is a friendly and helpful person who shows his support from first day. Strongly recommend for family and solo.

reviews.text:
Muhsin bey süreç öncesinde, süresince ve sonrasında her zaman ulaşılabilir olmasıyla birlikte birçok konuda yardımcı olmaya çalıştı. Evin içerisi oldukça temiz ve düzenliydi. Bulgurlu metroya 5 dakika yürüme mesafesinde ki bu büyük bir artı bence.

Apartment matches the photos and my expectations. You get a great value for the price in this location.
Stayed here for the 2nd time, it is a great value for money. The apartment matches the photos so you get what you see. Muhsin is very friendly and always trying to be helpful. Thank you!

The spacious terrace with its stunning view of the Anatolian side of the city was a definite highlight. Waking up to such a breathtaking panorama was an unforgettable experience. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped, making my stay incredibly enjoyable. Muhsin was a fantastic host, always responsive and helpful.
Excellent location, close to metro station, very peaceful and cosy place, mr. Muhsin is very friendly and helpful, gret value for money and finally 10/10 terrace!

description: Welcome to Suite 7, where Istanbul's Bosphorus view is boundless. Enjoy an unrivaled panorama stretching across the city from your window, then explore key attractions like Taksim Square, the Historical Peninsula, and Galataport just steps away. Back in your suite, chic décor and modern amenities offer luxury at every turn. Experience Istanbul from the top with Suite 7, your limitless home with a view.

reviews.text: What I liked most about my stay with Mr. Mehmed was the stunning view. Had it not been for the fact that the residence is located on a high floor that requires climbing stairs, but my host helped me carry bags and provided a distinguished service from the speed of response and response to my inquiries at any time, contributing to me feeling comfortable, in addition to the secure building and the picturesque location, opposite the port and Galata Mall, which is famous for its brands, and close to Takseem Street.

Perfect location with beautiful scenic views. Easy access Galata port across the street. Many restaurants and supermarkets nearby. Mehmet is the one of the best hosts that I met before. His kindness is amazing. When checking in and out, he touched us before and helped to carry luggages and he introduced app which can order groceries and foods and even he called taxi on behalf of us.
His home is more beautiful, spacious and clean than photo! Everything was great great great especially Mehmet!! Thank you!

This really was undeniably the best location, close to everything. The apartment was perfect, it was spacious, clean, serviced on request, had everything we required and excellent WiFi. The view of the Bosphorus has to be the best anywhere. It were spectacular, from the morning sunrises over the bridge, to the docking of the massive cruise ships right in front of you, to the endless viewing of the cargo ships, submarines, NATO war ships, tourist boats …..we sat for hours watching this. Open view of the Sea of Marama, we could clearly see what was coming in to dock. The Galataport is in front of you, Karakoy a few mins walk and the T1 tram 5 mins walk. The only downside was the 167 steps we had to climb to get to apartment 7. Don’t understand the trek, especially after a long day of walking. We had assistance taking bags up and down, but it is not easy especially if you are not keen on steps. But the view makes it all worthwhile!

description:
The flat is only 5 minutes walk away to world famous Blue Mosque and Hippodrome which are the heart of the old city, Istanbul.
The flat is on the 3rd floor with some view of the sea,trees and a one of the finest small mosque of Istanbul,Sokollu Mosque date back to 16th Century.
So the flat is not facing against some other apartments but this openness which We think is vey inspiring to get the experience of old Istanbul.

reviews.text:
The apartment is exactly as shown in the photos. The air conditioning works well, and the kitchen has everything you may need. The location is also very convenient. Considering the price, it could be one of the apartments worth considering.
The apartment is small and has low ceilings. It is on the 4th floor, and there is no elevator. There are no neighbors above, so you won’t have to worry about noise from upstairs.

I stayed here for a month and loved it. The apartment has large windows with beautiful natural light and faces the sea, which made waking up every morning a joy. As a Muslim, I also loved hearing the call to prayer, along with birds chirping in the mornings — it felt very peaceful and special compared to back home in Canada.
The space is roomy and comfortable. I worked remotely and the internet was reliable. The kitchen and laundry machine were useful since I didn’t want to eat out every meal and was staying long-term. The heating kept the place warm and cozy, and the neighbours were friendly. The apartment truly felt like home.
The location is excellent — walkable to mosques, grocery stores, restaurants, the sea, and the metro. It’s a hilly area with stairs, but I enjoyed the daily workout.
Kutay was a great host: responsive, flexible, and kind. He allowed early check-in and late check-out, and communication was always easy. I’d happily stay here again and highly recommend it.

First and foremost, stay here for the location and the incredible view of the mosque—it’s hard to beat. The host was very clear and upfront about the steep steps and the sound of the call to prayer, which I really appreciated. Nothing felt like a surprise, and honestly, each step up is worth it for that view.
The bed was comfortable, and the kitchen had enough utensils to put together a simple breakfast, which suited us well. That said, the apartment could use a bit of maintenance and some small updates.
Overall, we enjoyed our stay and would come back again, especially for the setting and atmosphere.

Kutay was a very responsive and helpful host. The bedroom and main living windows face an old mosque and other surrounds. Due to the elevated height, there were great views and it didnt feel closed in at all.
Each evening we went to the Blue Mosque and Hagia Sophia which was literally a 5min or so walk. We bought coffee, drinks or ice cream and sat near the fountain between the two mosques and enjoyed the atmosphere. It's simply a sight to behold (the two mosques), especially during the athaan.
Small shop around the corner to buy any essentials, and of course food and gift shops all over the place.
Going up to the apartment via the narrow staircase may be difficult if you are unfit or have access issues.

Kutay‘s place is good value for money, location is excellent for doing the main sightseeing in Istanbul. The place itself is ok for a short stay but it needs maintenance (curtains, air con) and would benefit from a deep clean. We were a bit annoyed that towels / cleaning clothes were left behind dirty in the laundry machine. Communication with Kutay was prompt and helpful.

description:

reviews.text:

I even accidentally mixed up my original arrival date, and the concierge/front desk staff were so kind and helpful. They assisted me with arranging a ride to my next stay, and I was able to return the following day for my correct booking without any stress.
I felt very safe in the location, very comfortable throughout my stay, and genuinely taken care of. I would absolutely recommend this Airbnb and would happily stay here again!!!

When it’s hot or icy, this would present problems unless you want to taxi everywhere. I messaged the Fraser people about a showerhead needing attention, an outlet and microwave not working well, and keeping to a cleaning schedule but none of that was addressed except a call 28 days in about housekeeping schedule. The hotel vs residents’ use of the fitness and sauna facilities was very confusing and I kept getting a different story on what I could use and not use. A few shuttles in the day, including to metro at 8a, which was a lifesaver. The reception staff was awesome. I won’t stay there again despite the great view and apartment because I need a place closer to public transport without having to climb mountains and arrive anywhere soaked. The area is super chill, taxis everywhere. Think on it!

description:
There are 2 rooms in the house: 1 living room and 1 bedroom.

You can easily access everything as a whole group from this centrally located place. It is 3 minutes walking distance to public transportation vehicles such as metro, metrobus, and Marmaray. It is a 10-minute walk to the sea.

With 65inc smart tv and 200mbit internet infrastructure, you can do your work in the working area, and you can do your daily sports in the sports area. You can prepare your own food with kitchen equipment.

reviews.text:
Caner is a wonderful host! He was really helpful and gave us plenty of recommendations, and when we had a problem with the hot water tank he came to the flat super quickly and helped us. He even got us some snacks to welcome us, which we really appreciated after a long journey.
The flat was spacious and clean and had everything we needed. The kitchen was well-stocked, and the bed was comfortable, and I appreciated having a workout area, too. There was a little bit of mold on the bathroom ceiling as it is tricky to ventilate it—not a problem for us but may be something to keep in mind if you have asthma for instance.
The location is well connected with a Marmaray station close by, a Metro within a walking distance, and lots of buses. You can reach the ferry station on foot or by bus. There are also shops and cafés nearby, and Caner gave us good advice to navigate them. Generally, Kadıköy is a lovely area so I'm glad we chose to stay there.
Thank you Caner for your hospitality!

This is a great place close to Sogutlucesme metro station in Kadikoy. The neighbourhood has several restaurants and supermarkets at walkable distances so it’s perfect to setup base for a few days.
The living room and bedroom are both wide and spacious, and receive sunlight throughout the day. The kitchen was fully equipped and ready to prepare quick meals before heading out for the day.
Special thanks to the host, Caner, for keeping snacks and drinks ready upon arrival - it was exactly what I needed after a long journey. He communicated proactively and provided clear instructions for self check-in.
Thanks for a great stay.

We stayed for a week for our first visit to Istambul, and I am really happy with the apartment an location.
It's away from the main tourist area, but starting each day with a walk thought the beatifull Kadikyo markets, and taking the see farry to wherever we needed, was probably the best part of the trip.
Amazing kebap and bars in the area, and shops are cheeper, with no scammers.
The apartment was big and comfortable, with everything that we needed.
It was a bit hot and noisy in the summer, but nothing unmanageable. (Apartments with AC usually cost double this price)
The host was amazing. Very responsive, adopted to our dynamic traveling plan. Nice welcome gifts and good advice when we needed something.

I had an amazing stay at this Airbnb! The location was perfect—right in the heart of the city, close to major attractions, public transportation, and great restaurants. It made exploring the city incredibly easy and enjoyable. The host was exceptionally friendly and accommodating, always quick to respond and eager to offer helpful tips about the area. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. I couldn’t have asked for a better experience. I would highly recommend staying here to anyone visiting Istanbul!

We had a wonderful stay in Turkey. The apartment was extremely clean, well-organized, and equipped with everything we needed, which made our stay very comfortable. The location is excellent — very close to public transportation and easy to get around.
The host, Cancer, was incredibly kind, responsive, and cooperative. Communication was smooth and fast, and he was always ready to help with anything we needed. His hospitality truly made a difference and made us feel at home.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a clean, comfortable stay with a great location and an outstanding host. We would definitely stay here again.

description: This is the house at the centre of Cihangir which is considered the home for artist, international people. You can easily find any kind of food, bakery, art galleries, transportations within 10 min walk. Taksim(İstiklal) is just 2 min away too. And the town is quite safe so you can walk 24/7. We are 2 min away from you in case of any need. The building is new and it is quite brand new so the furniture are brand new too. We do run airbnb in the building so you will have fun to stay here

reviews.text:
Thank you Özgür.
The place is very nice and looked exactly like the pictures.
The location is amazing, about 2 minutes walking distance to İstiklal Caddesi which is full of restaurants and a variety of shops.
The area is mostly flat and easy to walk around.
And if you’re up for it, it’s also a walking distance to Galata Kulesi, and you can even walk to Galataport!
The host was very nice and responsive, even helped us carry our luggage upstairs (there’s no elevator but it’s on the 2nd floor).
The place is spotless, organized and comfortable.
The heating in the apartment is amazing! I was wearing summer clothes inside during December.
One thing to pay attention to if you are a light sleeper or have children, the street is very loud at night.
Drivers put down the car windows and blast music from their cars every single night which was very annoying.
Earplugs or noise cancelling headphones can help.

First of all , the host was very nice. He helped with the bags at check-in. We had him few things removed due to children which he did quickly. Beds were very comfortable. floors and rooms were clean and modern. Washroom sink needs proper installation with a P or S trap but not big issue. Location is great. Most of all the Host himself is a very nice person responsive and helpful. Curtains were very good and can block sunlight completely. Heating is good. on top of that you can use two air conditioners. All the basic amenities were available. Will book definitely book his place again in the future. Good value for money!

First and foremost, what a wonderful host. Responded to my messages in seconds. The flat was just as described and the photos reflected the flat accurately. The flat has everything you need, just bring a toothbrush. I stayed here with 3 children and we found it ok for space, one of my children slept on the sofa which was comfortable. Everything was clean, WiFi was fast enough. I was a little apprehensive about some reviews that complained about the noise from the street at night, but it wasn't bad at all. It is situated on a busy road, and cars often make noise as well as the night life outside, but it didn't affect our sleep at all. The host even provided ear muffs! We didn't need this though. I'm quite a light sleeper and was ok. My baby daughter also slept through very easily despite sounds from the street. I was also apprehensive about reviews complaining of a smell from the toilet. The toilet is clean, to prevent the smell just keep the light on, extractor will keep the smell out.

Overall, it was a great place to stay. The location was excellent. We could reach most of the main attractions within a 10–15 minute walk. There were plenty of supermarkets, restaurants, and cafés nearby, which made everything very convenient. The apartment looks a bit larger in the photos, but in reality it’s a small space that’s still perfectly suitable for four people. The bathroom, floors, and bed linens were all very clean, though there was a small stain on one of the sheets. All the listed amenities such as the iron, hairdryer, etc. were available, but there weren’t quite enough spoons and forks for four guests. The apartment is located on the slopes of the Estiqlal Street area. It might be a bit challenging for elderly guests or those with mobility issues to walk up and down the slope. The area gets a bit busy on weekends, but it’s lively and adds to the overall experience. The host was very friendly and responsive, and thoughtfully provided earplugs for guests.

We had a great stay. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and in an amazing location just steps from Istiklal Street, with easy access to shopping, restaurants, culture, nightlife, and public transit. The host was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay, including answering the phone late at night when we forgot the access code. They also provided clear check-in instructions and were quick to bring us fresh towels when we asked.
The main thing to know is that the area is very lively and noisy at night because there are many bars downstairs. The host thoughtfully provides earplugs, which helped me sleep well, but light sleepers should keep this in mind. We also stayed on the third floor, so carrying luggage upstairs was a bit challenging. Overall, though, we felt well taken care of and really enjoyed the stay.

description:
Super bright and sunny place in Galata district. Brand new furnished apartment comes with 2 AC & 2 Bathroom & dedicated work space.

Two bedroom apartment in a very nice and quiet area close to famous Galata Tower, Istiklal Avenue, Karakoy, markets and public transport.

Located on the 1st floor in a building which was recently completely renovated.

I'm happy to welcome you as a friend and will happy to show you our hospitality!

reviews.text:
Apartment is beautiful and clean, very comfortable for 4 person with 2 bathrooms.
Located in walking distance to Galata tower and central streets.
Communication and check in was excellent and easy.
Description was with parking space, but they don't have it, so if coming with car you have garage for normal price and close.

Located directly at Gala Tower, the area is not the best, but we decided to stay there nonetheless. Unfortunately, it turned out to be a very bad experience, and we ended up leaving the apartment earlier than planned.
There was no prior notice about the check-in process, which caused a delay of over an hour. The WiFi password provided in the apartment didn’t match the one at the location. The apartment itself is old and worn out, despite the pictures making it seem new. It’s definitely at least 3 years old and heavily used.
The apartment was freezing cold upon arrival. There were no towels in the bathroom, and we had to search for them ourselves. The second bedroom only has blinds, and a large streetlight is positioned right outside the window, making it impossible to sleep. If you somehow manage to fall asleep, the noise from the neighbors will wake you up. The entire apartment is incredibly loud.
Overall, it’s not worth the money at all

Lovely apartment, exactly like what you see in the pictures. It was quite spacious and very appropriate for four people. The two bathrooms with great showers were very convenient for our group. The place was very clean and well kept.
It's worth noting that the apartment is located on a steep street, as so many in Istanbul, what hasn't bothered us at all but it could be challenging for people with limited mobility. The area is quite lively and it felt very safe.
Ali was a very engaged host who was in contact with us all the time and even managed to send us different pillows! Thank you, Ali!

Great central location and easy to find apartment. Host very responsive at start of stay and helpful in providing a second set of keys. Apartment matched pictures and was generally clean.
There was an issue with the soundproofing in the apartment as the other building residents were audible, partiularly when entering and leaving the property. The main bedroom had windows on two sides which was great for letting in the light during the day but did mean the street lights and noise from outside were tricky - at least until we stocked up with ear plugs and sleep masks! This wasn't an issue in the second bedroom.
Only disappointment was that after being so responsive initially at the end of our stay the hosts agreed to help get us a taxi back to the airport but then failed to reply to further messages which was very odd. Not a problem as we arranged an uber but a strange way to end an otherwise pleasant stay.

Absolutely perfect blend of location, comfort, and response. Just steps from Galata Tower, resturants, a wonderful vintage district, and transit. Apartment was literally a stones throw from coffee and grocery. Sultanahmet (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sofia) was an effortless 20 minute walk+tram away. Everything was as described and we had an extremely responsive host. Strongly recommend!
